  • Updating: if Science Club moves to Room 301, 3 records must be updated (one per member). Missing one gives inconsistent data.
  • Inserting: a new Maths Club with no members cannot be stored, because SID is the primary key and cannot be NULL.
  • Deleting: if Ada (the only Chess Club member) is deleted, the data of Chess Club is lost.
After splitting into STUDENT(SID, NAME, SEX, CLASS, SCORE, CID) and CLUB(CID, NAME, ROOM, TEACH), only 1 record is updated, a new club is stored in CLUB, and deleting a student does not lose club data.

Key sentence: Storing data in multiple tables linked with foreign keys makes it easier to maintain data consistency and saves data storage.
cards.zh:
Activity 3.1 把学会资料 (CNAME, CROOM, CTEACH) 放在 STUDENT 里，会出现三个问题：
  • 更新：Science Club 搬到 301 室，要改 3 条记录，漏改就数据不一致。
  • 插入：新的 Maths Club 还没有成员，无法储存，因为 SID 是 primary key，不能是 NULL。
  • 删除：删除 Ada 后，Chess Club 的资料也丢失。
拆成 STUDENT(…, CID) 和 CLUB(CID, NAME, ROOM, TEACH) 后：只改 1 条记录；新学会存进 CLUB；删除学生不会丢失学会资料。

要背：Storing data in multiple tables linked with foreign keys allows us to maintain data consistency easier and save data storage.

ex.q: A table ORDERS stores (OID, CUSTNAME, CUSTPHONE, ITEM). Customer Amy has 5 orders and changes her phone number. Explain the problem and suggest a better structure.
ex.a: Amy's phone is stored 5 times, so 5 records must be updated; if one is missed, the data becomes inconsistent. Better: CUSTOMER(CUSTID PK, CUSTNAME, CUSTPHONE) and ORDERS(OID PK, CUSTID FK, ITEM). Then the phone number is updated in one record only.
ex.az: 电话重复储存 5 次，要改 5 条记录，漏改便不一致。应拆成 CUSTOMER 和 ORDERS，用 CUSTID 作 foreign key 连接，只需改一条记录。

cards.tz: 多对多关系：中间表 SC
cards.en:
If each student may join more than one club, putting CID in STUDENT forces us to repeat the student's row (Clem appears 3 times with the same NAME, SEX, CLASS, SCORE). This is duplicated data: updating Clem means updating 3 records.

Solution: use three tables:
  • STUDENT(SID PK, NAME, SEX, CLASS, SCORE)
  • CLUB(CID PK, NAME, ROOM, TEACH)
  • SC(SID FK, CID FK): each row means 'this student joins this club'.
Advantage: a student may join as many clubs as they want without adding duplicated data to STUDENT. Clem simply has 3 rows in SC: (03496,1), (03496,2), (03496,4). To list students with club names we now join three tables through SC.
cards.zh:
若每位学生可参加多于一个学会，把 CID 放在 STUDENT 就要重复学生行（Clem 出现 3 次），造成 duplicated data：改 Clem 资料要改 3 条记录。

做法：用三个表：STUDENT(SID PK…)、CLUB(CID PK…)、SC(SID FK, CID FK)，SC 每一行表示“某学生参加某学会”。

好处：A student may join as many clubs as they want without adding duplicated data to STUDENT. Clem 在 SC 中有 3 行。要列出学生及学会名称，就要经 SC 连接三个表。

ex.q: Using STUDENT, SC and CLUB, how many rows does SC need if Eva joins Art Club and Science Club, and Ben joins no club?
ex.a: Eva needs 2 rows in SC: (03505, 2) and (03505, 4). Ben needs 0 rows; his record stays only in STUDENT. No student or club data is repeated.
ex.az: Eva 在 SC 有 2 行；Ben 没有参加学会，SC 中 0 行。

cards.en:
The result of INNER JOIN includes only the records with matching values in both tables. It can be simplified as JOIN.
SELECT * FROM STUDENT INNER JOIN CLUB
  ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
  • STUDENT is the left table, CLUB is the right table.
  • The ON clause gives the foreign key that links two tables.
  • Each matching pair of rows becomes one row in the result containing the fields of both tables.
With the sample data, Ben (CID is NULL, no club) and English Club (no student) are not included. The result has 6 rows. Use INNER JOIN when you only want records that have a partner in the other table.

Sample data used in 3.1: STUDENT(SID, NAME, SEX, CLASS, SCORE, CID): Ada 3A 0 CID 2; Clem 3B 89 CID 1; Eva 3B 83 CID 4; Gabe 3C 47 CID 4; Finn 3B 35 CID 1; Dio 3C 67 CID 4; Ben 3A 86 CID NULL. CLUB(CID, NAME, ROOM, TEACH): 1 Chess Club 501 Mr Chan; 2 Art Club 402 Mrs Lee; 3 English Club 203 Mr Suen; 4 Science Club 502 Mr Wong.
cards.zh:
The result of INNER JOIN includes only the records with matching values in both tables. 可简写为 JOIN。
SELECT * FROM STUDENT INNER JOIN CLUB
  ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
  • STUDENT 是左表 (left table)，CLUB 是右表 (right table)。
  • ON 后写连接两表的 foreign key。
  • 每对配对成功的记录合成结果中的一行，包含两表的栏位。
用课本数据：Ben（CID 为 NULL）和 English Club（没有学生）都不在结果中，结果共 6 行。只想要“两边都有配对”的记录时用 INNER JOIN。

ex.q: Using the sample STUDENT and CLUB tables, write a SQL statement to list each student's name and club room, excluding students without a club. How many rows are returned?
ex.a:
SELECT STUDENT.NAME, ROOM FROM STUDENT
  INNER JOIN CLUB ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
Ben has CID NULL, so he has no match and is dropped. 6 rows are returned (Ada 402, Clem 501, Eva 502, Gabe 502, Finn 501, Dio 502).
ex.az: INNER JOIN 只保留有配对的学生，Ben 被排除，共 6 行。

cards.en:
The result of LEFT JOIN includes all records in the left table and the records with matching values in both tables. It can be written as LEFT OUTER JOIN (an outer join).
SELECT * FROM STUDENT LEFT JOIN CLUB
  ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
  • Ben has no club but is still included, because STUDENT is the left table. His CLUB fields are filled with NULL.
  • English Club has no student and is in the right table, so it is not included.
  • The order of the two fields in ON does not matter: ON CLUB.CID = STUDENT.CID gives the same result. What matters is which table is written first (left).
Use LEFT JOIN when every record of the left table must appear, e.g. 'list every student with their club (if any)'. Result: 7 rows.
cards.zh:
The result of LEFT JOIN includes all records in the left table and the records with matching values in both tables. 又写作 LEFT OUTER JOIN（属于 outer join 外连接）。
SELECT * FROM STUDENT LEFT JOIN CLUB
  ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
  • Ben 没有学会，但 STUDENT 是左表，所以仍然出现，CLUB 的栏位全是 NULL。
  • English Club 没有学生，它在右表，所以不出现。
  • ON 里两个栏位谁先写没有影响；重要的是哪个表写在前面（左表）。
题目说“列出每一个学生（及其学会，如有）”时用 LEFT JOIN，结果 7 行。

ex.q: Write a SQL statement to list the name of every student and the name of their club, including students who have not joined a club. What is shown for Ben?
ex.a:
SELECT STUDENT.NAME, CLUB.NAME FROM STUDENT
  LEFT JOIN CLUB ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
Ben appears with NULL as the club name, because LEFT JOIN keeps all left-table records even without a match.
ex.az: Ben 出现，学会名称为 NULL。

cards.en:
The result of RIGHT JOIN includes all records in the right table and the records with matching values in both tables. It can be written as RIGHT OUTER JOIN.
SELECT * FROM STUDENT RIGHT JOIN CLUB
  ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
  • English Club has no student but is included (CLUB is the right table); its STUDENT fields are NULL.
  • Ben is not included (he is in the left table and has no match).
RIGHT JOIN can easily be replaced by LEFT JOIN by swapping the tables:
SELECT * FROM CLUB LEFT JOIN STUDENT
  ON CLUB.CID = STUDENT.CID
Both results are the same except the order of fields. (Note: older SQLite versions do not support RIGHT JOIN, so swap the tables and use LEFT JOIN.)
cards.zh:
The result of RIGHT JOIN includes all records in the right table and the records with matching values in both tables. 又写作 RIGHT OUTER JOIN。
  • English Club 没有学生，但 CLUB 是右表，所以包括在内，学生栏位为 NULL。
  • Ben 在左表又没有配对，所以不出现。
RIGHT JOIN 可以用 LEFT JOIN 代替：把两表位置对调，CLUB LEFT JOIN STUDENT，结果相同，只是栏位次序不同。（旧版 SQLite 不支援 RIGHT JOIN，可对调表再用 LEFT JOIN。）

ex.q: Rewrite without RIGHT JOIN: SELECT CLUB.NAME, STUDENT.NAME FROM STUDENT RIGHT JOIN CLUB ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
ex.a:
SELECT CLUB.NAME, STUDENT.NAME FROM CLUB
  LEFT JOIN STUDENT ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
Swap the tables so CLUB becomes the left table. All clubs (including English Club with NULL student) are kept. Because the SELECT list is written explicitly, even the column order is the same.
ex.az: 对调两表，用 LEFT JOIN；CLUB 变成左表，所有学会都保留。

cards.en:
The result of FULL JOIN includes records from both the left table and the right table. It can be written as FULL OUTER JOIN.
SELECT * FROM STUDENT FULL JOIN CLUB
  ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
Matching pairs are joined as usual; both Ben (no club, club fields NULL) and English Club (no student, student fields NULL) are included. Result: 8 rows.

Important: this keyword is not available in MySQL. The same result can be obtained by combining a LEFT JOIN and a RIGHT JOIN with UNION (see 3.3):
SELECT * FROM STUDENT LEFT JOIN CLUB ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
UNION
SELECT * FROM STUDENT RIGHT JOIN CLUB ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
UNION removes the duplicated matched rows, leaving every row once.
cards.zh:
The result of FULL JOIN includes records from both the left table and the right table. 又写作 FULL OUTER JOIN。配对成功的照常合并；Ben（学会栏位 NULL）和 English Club（学生栏位 NULL）都包括，共 8 行。

注意：MySQL 没有 FULL JOIN 这个关键字。可以用 LEFT JOIN 的结果 UNION RIGHT JOIN 的结果得到相同结果（见 3.3）；UNION 会删去重复的配对行。

ex.q: MySQL has no FULL JOIN. Write a statement that lists every student name and every club name, matched where possible, including Ben and English Club.
ex.a:
SELECT STUDENT.NAME, CLUB.NAME FROM STUDENT
  LEFT JOIN CLUB ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
UNION
SELECT STUDENT.NAME, CLUB.NAME FROM CLUB
  LEFT JOIN STUDENT ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
The first part keeps all students (Ben, NULL); the second keeps all clubs (NULL, English Club). UNION removes the repeated matched pairs.
ex.az: 左连接结果 UNION 另一方向的左连接结果，即可模拟 FULL JOIN。

cards.t: Comparing INNER, LEFT, RIGHT and FULL JOIN
cards.en:
Using STUDENT (left) and CLUB (right):
JoinBen (left, no match)English Club (right, no match)Rows
INNER JOINnot shownnot shown6
LEFT JOINshownnot shown7
RIGHT JOINnot shownshown7
FULL JOINshownshown8
Method to choose a join: decide which table is left and which is right, then ask 'whose unmatched records must be kept?'
  • keep neither → INNER
  • keep the left table's → LEFT
  • keep the right table's → RIGHT
  • keep both → FULL
Unmatched fields are filled with NULL. If the question guarantees every record has a match (e.g. 'every employee is part of a department'), INNER and the outer joins give the same result.
cards.zh:
以 STUDENT（左）和 CLUB（右）为例：INNER 6 行（Ben、English Club 都不出现）；LEFT 7 行（有 Ben）；RIGHT 7 行（有 English Club）；FULL 8 行（两者都有）。

选择方法：先定左表、右表，再问“哪一边没有配对的记录要保留？”
  • 都不要 → INNER
  • 保留左表 → LEFT
  • 保留右表 → RIGHT
  • 两边都要 → FULL
没有配对的栏位补 NULL。若题目保证每条记录都有配对（如“每个员工都属于一个部门”），INNER 和 outer join 结果相同。

ex.q: Table TEACHER(TID, NAME) and COURSE(CID, TITLE, TID). Some teachers teach no course; every course has a teacher. Which join lists every teacher with the titles of their courses, if any?
ex.a:
Every course has a teacher, so there are no unmatched courses. Some teachers are unmatched and must be kept. With TEACHER on the left: LEFT JOIN.
SELECT NAME, TITLE FROM TEACHER t
  LEFT JOIN COURSE c ON t.TID = c.TID
(Equivalently COURSE RIGHT JOIN TEACHER.)
ex.az: 要保留没有课程的老师（左表），用 LEFT JOIN。

cards.t: Selecting, filtering and sorting joined records
cards.tz: 连接后选择栏位、筛选和排序
cards.en:
After joining, we can select specific fields, filter and sort as usual:
SELECT SID, STUDENT.NAME, CLASS, CLUB.NAME, ROOM
FROM STUDENT LEFT JOIN CLUB ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
WHERE SCORE >= 60
ORDER BY CLASS
Result: Ben 3A NULL NULL; Clem 3B Chess Club 501; Eva 3B Science Club 502; Dio 3C Science Club 502.

Key point: both tables have a field called NAME, so we must specify which table the field comes from (STUDENT.NAME, CLUB.NAME). Fields that exist in only one table (SID, CLASS, ROOM, SCORE) need no prefix. Writing just NAME would be ambiguous and cause an error.

Order of clauses: SELECT … FROM … JOIN … ON … WHERE … GROUP BY … HAVING … ORDER BY.
cards.zh:
连接之后可照常选取栏位、筛选、排序（见上例）。结果：Ben 3A NULL NULL；Clem 3B Chess Club 501；Eva 3B Science Club 502；Dio 3C Science Club 502。

重点：两表都有 NAME 栏位，所以必须注明来自哪个表（STUDENT.NAME、CLUB.NAME），否则会出现 ambiguous 错误。只在一个表出现的栏位（SID、CLASS、ROOM）不用加表名。

子句次序：SELECT … FROM … JOIN … ON … WHERE … GROUP BY … HAVING … ORDER BY。

ex.q: List the name and room of the club of every female student, sorted by room. Include female students without a club.
ex.a:
SELECT STUDENT.NAME, ROOM FROM STUDENT
  LEFT JOIN CLUB ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
WHERE SEX = 'F'
ORDER BY ROOM
STUDENT.NAME is needed because CLUB also has NAME. Result: Ada 402, Clem 501, Eva 502.
ex.az: 两表都有 NAME，要写 STUDENT.NAME；WHERE 筛选女生，再按 ROOM 排序。

cards.en:
We may shorten a statement by giving each table an alias in FROM:
SELECT SID, s.NAME, CLASS, c.NAME, ROOM
FROM STUDENT s LEFT JOIN CLUB c ON s.CID = c.CID
WHERE SCORE >= 60 ORDER BY CLASS
Here s and c refer to STUDENT and CLUB. Once a table has an alias, use the alias (s.NAME) in the rest of the statement.

To avoid confusion, fields that share the same name may be renamed using a column alias with AS:
SELECT SID, s.NAME, CLASS, c.NAME AS CLUBNAME, ROOM
FROM STUDENT s LEFT JOIN CLUB c ON s.CID = c.CID
Now the result has columns NAME and CLUBNAME instead of two NAME columns. Aliases are required for a self join (same table twice) and very useful when joining three or more tables.
cards.zh:
可以在 FROM 给每个表起别名 (alias) 来缩短语句：STUDENT s、CLUB c，之后用 s.NAME、c.NAME。

同名栏位可用 AS 改名（column alias），例如 c.NAME AS CLUBNAME，结果就有 NAME 和 CLUBNAME 两栏，不会混淆。

Self join（同一表用两次）必须用表别名；连接三个或以上的表时别名也很有用。

ex.q: Rewrite with aliases s and c, and rename the club name column to CNAME: SELECT STUDENT.NAME, CLUB.NAME FROM STUDENT INNER JOIN CLUB ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
ex.a:
SELECT s.NAME, c.NAME AS CNAME
FROM STUDENT s INNER JOIN CLUB c ON s.CID = c.CID
ex.az: FROM 中写 STUDENT s、CLUB c；用 AS CNAME 给学会名称改名。

cards.t: Summarising joined data: GROUP BY and HAVING
cards.tz: 连接后汇总：GROUP BY 与 HAVING
cards.en:
We may summarise data obtained by joining tables:
SELECT c.NAME, AVG(SCORE)
FROM STUDENT s LEFT JOIN CLUB c ON s.CID = c.CID
WHERE s.SID <> '03506'
GROUP BY c.CID
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
Steps: (1) join; (2) WHERE removes Gabe (03506) before grouping; (3) GROUP BY c.CID forms groups Art (Ada 0), Chess (89, 35), Science (83, 67) and a NULL group (Ben 86); (4) HAVING keeps groups with more than 1 student.
Result: Chess Club 62, Science Club 75.

Note: students with no club form a NULL group. If several students had no club, the NULL group would have COUNT(*) > 1 and its average would also be shown. To exclude it, add WHERE s.CID IS NOT NULL or use INNER JOIN.
cards.zh:
连接后的结果也可以汇总（见上例）。步骤：(1) 连接；(2) WHERE 在分组前删去 Gabe；(3) GROUP BY c.CID 分成 Art (0)、Chess (89, 35)、Science (83, 67) 和 NULL 组 (Ben 86)；(4) HAVING 只保留人数多于 1 的组。结果：Chess Club 62、Science Club 75。

注意：没有学会的学生会组成 NULL 组；若有多名这样的学生，NULL 组的平均分也会显示。要排除可加 WHERE s.CID IS NOT NULL 或改用 INNER JOIN。

ex.q: List each club name and the number of students in it, including clubs with no students (show 0).
ex.a:
SELECT c.NAME, COUNT(s.SID) FROM CLUB c
  LEFT JOIN STUDENT s ON s.CID = c.CID
GROUP BY c.CID
CLUB is the left table so English Club is kept. COUNT(s.SID) ignores NULL, giving 0 for English Club (COUNT(*) would wrongly give 1). Result: Chess 2, Art 1, English 0, Science 3.
ex.az: CLUB 作左表保留 English Club；用 COUNT(s.SID) 而不是 COUNT(*)，才会得到 0。

cards.en:
Tables: EMPLOYEE(ID, ENAME, DEPID, TEAMID, SALARY), TEAM(ID, TNAME, LEADID, MEMNUM), DEPARTMENT(ID, DNAME).
  • (a)(i) Every employee is in a department; departments with no employee must not appear. With EMPLOYEE on the left: LEFT JOIN or INNER JOIN (RIGHT JOIN would add empty departments).
    SELECT ENAME, DNAME FROM EMPLOYEE
  LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT ON DEPID = DEPARTMENT.ID
  • (ii) Some teams have no leader; list every team with its leader (if any). TEAM on the left: LEFT JOIN on LEADID = EMPLOYEE.ID.
    SELECT TNAME, ENAME FROM TEAM
  LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE ON LEADID = EMPLOYEE.ID
  • (iii) Include teams with no employee: TEAM LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE on TEAM.ID = TEAMID.
Watch the foreign key: the same two tables can be linked by different fields (LEADID for leaders, TEAMID for members), giving different meanings.
cards.zh:
表：EMPLOYEE、TEAM、DEPARTMENT。
  • (a)(i) 每个员工都有部门，且不要没有员工的部门：EMPLOYEE 在左，用 LEFT 或 INNER JOIN（RIGHT 会多出空部门）。
  • (ii) 有些 team 没有 leader，要列出所有 team：TEAM 在左，LEFT JOIN，连接条件是 LEADID = EMPLOYEE.ID。
  • (iii) 要包括没有员工的 team：TEAM LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE，条件 TEAM.ID = TEAMID。
留意 foreign key：同样两个表可以用不同栏位连接（LEADID 找组长，TEAMID 找组员），意义不同。

ex.q: Using EMPLOYEE and TEAM, list each employee's name with their team name, including employees not yet assigned to any team.
ex.a:
SELECT ENAME, TNAME FROM EMPLOYEE
  LEFT JOIN TEAM ON TEAMID = TEAM.ID
The unmatched employees are in EMPLOYEE, so EMPLOYEE is the left table with LEFT JOIN. The link is TEAMID (membership), not LEADID.
ex.az: 没有 team 的员工要保留，EMPLOYEE 作左表用 LEFT JOIN，连接 TEAMID。

cards.t: Derived field MEMNUM and COUNT(field) vs COUNT(*)
cards.tz: 可计算的栏位 MEMNUM 与 COUNT(栏位) vs COUNT(*)
cards.en:
In Example 3.1, TEAM stores MEMNUM (number of employees). Whenever a new employee is added to a team, MEMNUM must also be updated, otherwise it causes data inconsistency. Since the value can be calculated using a function, it should not be stored:
SELECT TNAME, COUNT(ENAME) FROM EMPLOYEE
  RIGHT JOIN TEAM ON TEAMID = TEAM.ID
GROUP BY TEAM.ID
Traps:
  • LEFT JOIN (EMPLOYEE left) misses teams with no employee (team Delta).
  • RIGHT JOIN with COUNT(*) gives Delta a count of 1, because the row (NULL, Delta) is still a row.
  • COUNT(ENAME) does not count NULL values, so Delta correctly gets 0.
Rule: after an outer join, count a field that is NULL for unmatched rows (e.g. the other table's key or name), not *.
cards.zh:
Example 3.1 的 TEAM 储存 MEMNUM（组员人数）。每加入新员工都要更新 MEMNUM，否则造成 data inconsistency。这个值可以用函数计算，所以不应储存（见上面语句）。
陷阱：
  • EMPLOYEE 作左表的 LEFT JOIN 会漏掉没有员工的 team (Delta)。
  • RIGHT JOIN 配 COUNT(*)，Delta 会得到 1，因为 (NULL, Delta) 也是一行。
  • COUNT(ENAME) 不计 NULL，Delta 正确地得 0。
规则：外连接后要数对没有配对的行为 NULL 的栏位，不要用 *。

ex.q: Teams: Alpha(1), Beta(2), Gamma(3), Delta(4). Employees' TEAMID: 1, 2, 3, 3, 2. What does SELECT TNAME, COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEE RIGHT JOIN TEAM ON TEAMID = TEAM.ID GROUP BY TEAM.ID give for Delta, and how do you fix it?
ex.a: Delta has no employee, but RIGHT JOIN produces one row (NULL employee, Delta), so COUNT(*) = 1 (wrong). Fix: use COUNT(ENAME) (or COUNT(EMPLOYEE.ID)), which ignores NULL and gives 0.
ex.az: COUNT(*) 得 1（错）；改用 COUNT(ENAME) 得 0。

cards.tz: 连接后 WHERE 与 HAVING 的分别
cards.en:
Task: find every team's average salary, excluding teams with an average salary below 20000.
✗ Wrong:
SELECT TNAME, AVG(SALARY) FROM EMPLOYEE
  RIGHT JOIN TEAM ON TEAMID = TEAM.ID
WHERE SALARY >= 20000 GROUP BY TEAM.ID
WHERE filters data before categorisation (grouping). This statement excludes employees earning below 20000 from the calculation, instead of excluding teams.
✓ Correct:
SELECT TNAME, AVG(SALARY) FROM EMPLOYEE
  RIGHT JOIN TEAM ON TEAMID = TEAM.ID
GROUP BY TEAM.ID HAVING AVG(SALARY) >= 20000
HAVING filters groups after grouping, using aggregate values. A team with no employees has AVG = NULL; HAVING also filters it out.
Rule: condition on individual records → WHERE; condition on a summary (AVG, COUNT, SUM) → HAVING. HAVING must come after GROUP BY.
cards.zh:
题目：求每个 team 的平均薪金，排除平均薪金低于 20000 的 team。
✗ 用 WHERE SALARY >= 20000：WHERE 在分组前过滤，结果变成“计算平均时排除薪金低于 20000 的员工”，而不是排除 team。
✓ 用 GROUP BY TEAM.ID HAVING AVG(SALARY) >= 20000：HAVING 在分组后过滤组。没有员工的 team AVG 为 NULL，也会被 HAVING 过滤。
规则：条件针对个别记录 → WHERE；针对汇总值 (AVG/COUNT/SUM) → HAVING，且 HAVING 要放在 GROUP BY 之后。

ex.q: Checkpoint 3.1(c) idea: find each shop's average product price, excluding products priced at 1000 or more from the calculation. Is 'GROUP BY s.SID HAVING PRICE > 1000' correct?
ex.a:
No. Two mistakes: the condition is on individual products, so it belongs in WHERE (before grouping), and the comparison should be PRICE < 1000 (keep cheaper products). Also NAME must be qualified.
SELECT s.NAME, AVG(PRICE) FROM SHOP s
  LEFT JOIN PROD p ON s.SID = p.SID
WHERE PRICE < 1000 GROUP BY s.SID
ex.az: 排除个别产品要用 WHERE（分组前），条件是 PRICE < 1000。

cards.en:
Equi-join is just another way to perform INNER JOIN. List the tables in FROM, separated by commas, and write the matching condition in WHERE:
SELECT * FROM STUDENT, CLUB WHERE STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
gives the same result as
SELECT * FROM STUDENT INNER JOIN CLUB ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID
Key points:
  • Unmatched records (Ben, English Club) are not included, exactly like INNER JOIN.
  • Other conditions are added with AND: WHERE STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID AND SCORE > 50.
  • Equi-join is short and convenient when joining many tables, if no unmatched records need to be kept.
  • If you forget the WHERE condition, every row is paired with every row (a CROSS JOIN), giving a wrong, very large result.
cards.zh:
Equi-join is just another way to perform INNER JOIN. 在 FROM 用逗号列出多个表，在 WHERE 写相等条件。结果与 INNER JOIN 完全相同：没有配对的记录（Ben、English Club）不会出现。
  • 其他条件用 AND 加上。
  • 连接多个表又不用保留无配对记录时，equi-join 写法较短。
  • 忘记写 WHERE 条件，就会变成每行配每行（CROSS JOIN），结果错误又很大。

ex.q: Rewrite as an equi-join: SELECT s.NAME, c.ROOM FROM STUDENT s INNER JOIN CLUB c ON s.CID = c.CID WHERE c.TEACH = 'Mr Wong'
ex.a:
SELECT s.NAME, c.ROOM FROM STUDENT s, CLUB c
WHERE s.CID = c.CID AND c.TEACH = 'Mr Wong'
Result: Eva, Gabe, Dio (all room 502).
ex.az: 把表用逗号列在 FROM，连接条件和其他条件都写在 WHERE，用 AND 连接。

cards.en:
NATURAL JOIN is the same as INNER JOIN, except that it automatically joins on fields that share the same name in both tables.
SELECT * FROM STUDENT NATURAL JOIN CLUB
No ON clause is written. Danger: STUDENT and CLUB share two field names, NAME and CID. NATURAL JOIN would join on both, requiring the student's name to equal the club's name, which is meaningless (NAME is not a foreign key). So these two tables cannot be joined properly using NATURAL JOIN.
Fix in the book: rename CLUB.NAME to CLUBNAME; now only CID is shared, and
SELECT * FROM STUDENT NATURAL JOIN CLUB
gives the same result as STUDENT INNER JOIN CLUB ON STUDENT.CID = CLUB.CID (the common field CID appears once).
Use NATURAL JOIN only when the only common field name is the foreign key.
cards.zh:
NATURAL JOIN is the same as INNER JOIN, except that it automatically joins on fields that share the same name in both tables. 不用写 ON。
危险：STUDENT 和 CLUB 有两个同名栏位 NAME 和 CID，NATURAL JOIN 会同时以两者连接，要求学生名等于学会名，毫无意义（NAME 不是 foreign key）。所以这两个表不能直接用 NATURAL JOIN。
课本做法：把 CLUB.NAME 改名为 CLUBNAME，只剩 CID 同名，NATURAL JOIN 就等于以 CID 做 INNER JOIN。
只有在唯一同名栏位是 foreign key 时才用 NATURAL JOIN。

ex.q: Tables ORDERS(OID, CUSTID, DATE) and CUSTOMER(CUSTID, CNAME, DATE), where DATE in CUSTOMER is the registration date. Why is ORDERS NATURAL JOIN CUSTOMER wrong for listing each order with its customer name?
ex.a:
The tables share two field names, CUSTID and DATE. NATURAL JOIN joins on both, so only orders placed on the same day the customer registered would be returned. DATE is not a foreign key. Use:
SELECT OID, CNAME FROM ORDERS o
  INNER JOIN CUSTOMER c ON o.CUSTID = c.CUSTID
ex.az: 两表有两个同名栏位 CUSTID 和 DATE，NATURAL JOIN 会连 DATE，结果错误；应用 INNER JOIN … ON CUSTID。

cards.en:
Self join means joining a table to itself. We must give the table two different aliases so the DBMS treats it as two different tables temporarily.
STUDENT has field CMSID = the SID of the class monitor (who is also a student):
SELECT s1.NAME, s2.NAME AS CMNAME FROM STUDENT s1
  INNER JOIN STUDENT s2 ON s1.CMSID = s2.SID
s1 plays the role of 'the student', s2 plays 'the monitor'. Result: Ada–Ben, Clem–Eva, Eva–Eva, Gabe–Dio, Finn–Eva, Dio–Dio, Ben–Ben.

Typical uses: an employee and their manager in one table (MANAGERID → EID), a person and their mentor, comparing records of the same table (pairs). Without aliases, the statement is ambiguous and fails.
cards.zh:
Self join means joining a table to itself. 必须给同一个表两个不同的别名，DBMS 才会暂时把它当作两个表。
STUDENT 的 CMSID 是班长的 SID（班长也是学生）：s1 当“学生”，s2 当“班长”，条件 s1.CMSID = s2.SID。结果：Ada–Ben、Clem–Eva、Eva–Eva、Gabe–Dio、Finn–Eva、Dio–Dio、Ben–Ben。

常见用途：同一表中员工与上司 (MANAGERID → EID)、比较同一表的记录（配对）。没有别名会出错。

ex.q: EMPLOYEE(EID, NAME, MANAGERID). Write a statement listing each employee's name with their manager's name as MANAGER.
ex.a:
SELECT e1.NAME, e2.NAME AS MANAGER
FROM EMPLOYEE e1, EMPLOYEE e2
WHERE e1.MANAGERID = e2.EID
e1 = the employee, e2 = the manager. (Use e1 LEFT JOIN e2 ON … to also keep employees with no manager.)
ex.az: e1 是员工，e2 是上司，条件 e1.MANAGERID = e2.EID。

cards.t: Self join for pairing: removing self-pairs and duplicates
cards.tz: 自连接配对：去除自己配自己与重复配对
cards.en:
To find study partners whose scores differ by less than 16:
SELECT s1.NAME, s1.SCORE, s2.NAME, s2.SCORE
FROM STUDENT s1, STUDENT s2
WHERE ABS(s1.SCORE - s2.SCORE) < 16
Problems: it pairs a student with themselves (Ada & Ada) and returns duplicated pairs (Ben & Clem and Clem & Ben).
Fix: add s1.SID < s2.SID:
... WHERE ABS(s1.SCORE - s2.SCORE) < 16 AND s1.SID < s2.SID
Why it works: the two SIDs must be different (no self-pairing), and of each duplicated pair only one has the smaller SID first. Result: Ben–Clem, Eva–Clem, Ben–Eva, Gabe–Finn.

If the higher scorer must be listed first, use s1.SCORE >= s2.SCORE AND s1.SID <> s2.SID instead.
cards.zh:
找分数相差少于 16 的学习伙伴，直接自连接会出现两个问题：自己配自己（Ada & Ada）以及重复配对（Ben & Clem 与 Clem & Ben）。
解决：加 s1.SID < s2.SID。原因：两个 SID 必须不同（不会自配），而每对重复配对中只有一个符合“前者 SID 较小”。结果：Ben–Clem、Eva–Clem、Ben–Eva、Gabe–Finn。

若要分数较高者排在前面，改用 s1.SCORE >= s2.SCORE AND s1.SID <> s2.SID。

ex.q: PLAYER(ID, NAME, LEVEL). Two players can battle if their level difference is at most 5; a player cannot battle themselves and no duplicate pairs are allowed. Write the statement (Checkpoint 3.3(e)).
ex.a:
SELECT p1.NAME, p1.LEVEL, p2.NAME, p2.LEVEL
FROM PLAYER p1, PLAYER p2
WHERE ABS(p1.LEVEL - p2.LEVEL) <= 5 AND p1.ID < p2.ID
ex.az: 自连接 PLAYER，等级差 ≤ 5，用 p1.ID < p2.ID 去除自配与重复。

cards.en:
With STUDENT, SC and CLUB, we chain several joins through the linking table SC:
SELECT s.SID, s.NAME, c.NAME AS CLUBNAME FROM STUDENT s
  LEFT JOIN SC ON SC.SID = s.SID
  LEFT JOIN CLUB c ON c.CID = SC.CID
Step 1: STUDENT LEFT JOIN SC gives one row per (student, club) and Ben with NULL CID. Step 2: that result LEFT JOIN CLUB adds the club name. Clem appears 3 times (Chess, Art, Science); Ben appears with NULL.

We may also use equi-join:
SELECT s.SID, s.NAME, c.NAME AS CLUBNAME
FROM STUDENT s, SC, CLUB c
WHERE SC.SID = s.SID AND c.CID = SC.CID
but then Ben is not in the result, because equi-join is an INNER JOIN. For n tables, you normally need n − 1 join conditions.
cards.zh:
经中间表 SC 串连多个 JOIN（见上例）：第一步 STUDENT LEFT JOIN SC，每个（学生, 学会）一行，Ben 的 CID 为 NULL；第二步再 LEFT JOIN CLUB 加入学会名称。Clem 出现 3 次，Ben 出现且学会为 NULL。

也可用 equi-join（FROM STUDENT s, SC, CLUB c WHERE …），但 equi-join 是 INNER JOIN，Ben 不会出现。连接 n 个表通常需要 n − 1 个连接条件。

ex.q: List the name of every student in Science Club using STUDENT, SC and CLUB.
ex.a:
SELECT s.NAME FROM STUDENT s, SC, CLUB c
WHERE SC.SID = s.SID AND c.CID = SC.CID
  AND c.NAME = 'Science Club'
Three tables need two join conditions plus the filter. Result: Clem, Eva, Gabe, Dio.
ex.az: 三个表需要两个连接条件，再加筛选条件。

cards.en:
To show all of Clem's clubs in one row instead of three, use GROUP_CONCAT(), which joins the string values of a group into one string separated by commas:
SELECT s.NAME, GROUP_CONCAT(c.NAME) AS CNAME FROM STUDENT s
  LEFT JOIN SC ON SC.SID = s.SID
  LEFT JOIN CLUB c ON c.CID = SC.CID
GROUP BY s.SID
Result: Ada – Art Club; Clem – Science Club,Art Club,Chess Club; Eva – Science Club; …; Ben – NULL.
  • It is an aggregate function, so it needs GROUP BY (one row per group).
  • The order inside the string is not guaranteed unless specified (MySQL: GROUP_CONCAT(c.NAME ORDER BY c.NAME)).
  • It works in both MySQL and SQLite.
cards.zh:
要把 Clem 的三个学会显示在同一行，可以用 GROUP_CONCAT()：把一组的字串值以逗号连成一个字串（见上例）。结果：Clem – Science Club,Art Club,Chess Club；Ben – NULL。
  • 它是聚合函数，要配合 GROUP BY。
  • 字串内的次序不保证（MySQL 可写 ORDER BY）。
  • MySQL 和 SQLite 都支援。

ex.q: Using CLUB, SC and STUDENT, list each club name with the names of its members in one row.
ex.a:
SELECT c.NAME, GROUP_CONCAT(s.NAME) AS MEMBERS FROM CLUB c
  LEFT JOIN SC ON SC.CID = c.CID
  LEFT JOIN STUDENT s ON s.SID = SC.SID
GROUP BY c.CID
English Club (no member) shows NULL.
ex.az: 以 CLUB 为左表，按学会分组，用 GROUP_CONCAT 合并学生名字。

cards.t: Example 3.2: three tables and two copies of one table
cards.tz: Example 3.2：三表连接与同一表的两个副本
cards.en:
EMPLOYEE(ID, ENAME, SEX, TEAMID, SALARY), TEAM(ID, TNAME, LEADID, DEPID), DEPARTMENT(ID, DNAME). Every employee is in a team, every team has employees and a department, every department has teams. So INNER JOIN / equi-join will not miss data, and the shorter equi-join is fine.
  • (a)
    SELECT ENAME, DNAME FROM EMPLOYEE e, TEAM t, DEPARTMENT d
WHERE TEAMID = t.ID AND DEPID = d.ID ORDER BY d.ID
  • (b) head count per team: GROUP BY t.ID ORDER BY t.ID with COUNT(*).
  • (c) Each employee with their team leader: the leader is also an employee, so we need two copies of EMPLOYEE with different aliases (e = member, l = leader):
    SELECT e.ENAME, l.ENAME AS LNAME FROM EMPLOYEE e, TEAM t, EMPLOYEE l
WHERE e.TEAMID = t.ID AND LEADID = l.ID ORDER BY e.ID
  • (d) WHERE … AND DNAME LIKE 'IT%' GROUP BY d.ID ORDER BY SUM(SALARY) DESC
  • (e) average salary per sex per department: GROUP BY d.ID, SEX ORDER BY DNAME, SEX
cards.zh:
由于每个员工都有 team、每个 team 都有员工和部门、每个部门都有 team，用 INNER JOIN / equi-join 不会遗漏资料，可用较短的 equi-join。
  • (a) 三表 equi-join，按 d.ID 排序。
  • (b) 每个 team 人数：GROUP BY t.ID，COUNT(*)。
  • (c) 组长也是员工，所以要用两个 EMPLOYEE 副本，不同别名（e 组员、l 组长），条件 e.TEAMID = t.ID AND LEADID = l.ID。
  • (d) DNAME LIKE 'IT%'，按部门分组，按 SUM(SALARY) 降序。
  • (e) 按部门和性别分组 GROUP BY d.ID, SEX。

ex.q: Using the tables of Example 3.2, list each department name and its number of employees, sorted by the number of employees in descending order.
ex.a:
SELECT DNAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM
FROM DEPARTMENT d, TEAM t, EMPLOYEE e
WHERE d.ID = DEPID AND TEAMID = t.ID
GROUP BY d.ID ORDER BY NUM DESC
ex.az: 三表 equi-join，按部门分组计数，再降序排序。

cards.en:
CROSS JOIN does not need a foreign key to join on. It simply matches each row of the left table to each row of the right table. The result is every combination (a Cartesian product): if L has m rows and R has n rows, the result has m × n rows.
SELECT * FROM L CROSS JOIN R ORDER BY LID, RID
L = {A, B, C}, R = {D, E, F} → 9 rows: A D, A E, A F, B D, …, C F.

We may omit the keyword: listing tables in FROM without a join condition performs a CROSS JOIN:
SELECT * FROM L, R
This is also why forgetting the WHERE condition in an equi-join produces a huge wrong result.
cards.zh:
CROSS JOIN does not need a foreign key to join on. It simply matches each row of the left table to each row of the right table. 即每个组合（笛卡儿积）：L 有 m 行、R 有 n 行，结果有 m × n 行。L = {A, B, C}、R = {D, E, F} → 9 行。

可以省略关键字：FROM 列出多个表而不写连接条件就是 CROSS JOIN（SELECT * FROM L, R）。这也解释了 equi-join 忘记 WHERE 条件时结果为何又大又错。

ex.q: Table SIZE has 3 rows (S, M, L) and COLOUR has 4 rows. How many rows does SELECT * FROM SIZE CROSS JOIN COLOUR return? Give a use.
ex.a: 3 × 4 = 12 rows. Use: listing every size–colour combination of a T-shirt, e.g. to generate all product variants.
ex.az: 3 × 4 = 12 行，可用于列出所有尺码与颜色的组合。

cards.t: CROSS JOIN in practice: buyers and sellers
cards.tz: CROSS JOIN 实际应用：买家与卖家
cards.en:
BUYER(BNAME, NA, NO) gives the numbers of apples and oranges each buyer needs; SELLER(SNAME, PA, PO) gives each seller's prices. To find the cheapest seller for each buyer, compute the cost of every buyer–seller combination:
SELECT BNAME, SNAME, PA*NA+PO*NO AS COST
FROM BUYER CROSS JOIN SELLER
ORDER BY BNAME, COST
Sorting by BNAME then COST puts the cheapest seller first in each buyer's group: Ada → Finn ($135.8), Ben → Eva ($183.6), Clem → Dio ($162.6).
Ada's costs: Dio 13.1×4 + 12.0×7 = 136.4; Eva 11.2×4 + 13.8×7 = 141.4; Finn 14.0×4 + 11.4×7 = 135.8.

The same can be written FROM BUYER, SELLER. CROSS JOIN is useful when no relationship links the tables but every combination must be evaluated.
cards.zh:
BUYER 记录每个买家要买的苹果和橙数目；SELLER 记录每个卖家的价格。要找每个买家最便宜的卖家，就计算每个买家与每个卖家的组合的成本（见上例）。先按 BNAME 再按 COST 排序，每个买家组的第一行就是最便宜的卖家：Ada → Finn ($135.8)、Ben → Eva ($183.6)、Clem → Dio ($162.6)。
Ada：Dio 13.1×4 + 12.0×7 = 136.4；Eva 141.4；Finn 135.8。

也可写 FROM BUYER, SELLER。表之间没有关系但要评估所有组合时就用 CROSS JOIN。

ex.q: Using BUYER and SELLER, compute Ben's (NA = 9, NO = 6) cost with Eva (PA = 11.2, PO = 13.8) and Dio (PA = 13.1, PO = 12.0). Which is cheaper?
ex.az: Eva 183.6，Dio 189.9，Eva 较便宜。

cards.t: Subquery: a query inside another query
cards.en:
To find the name of the student with the highest score, one function is not enough. We need a query inside another query, called a subquery. It utilises the result of a query in another query.
Step 1: SELECT MAX(SCORE) FROM STUDENT → 89.
Step 2: SELECT NAME, SCORE FROM STUDENT WHERE SCORE = 89 → Clem.
Step 3: substitute the first query for 89 and enclose it in parentheses:
SELECT NAME, SCORE FROM STUDENT
WHERE SCORE = (SELECT MAX(SCORE) FROM STUDENT)
The inner query runs first and its result is used by the outer (main) query. This also works if two students share the top score: both are listed.

Tip: a subquery after a comparison operator such as =, >, < must return a single value, otherwise the statement results in errors.
cards.zh:
要找最高分学生的名字，单靠一个函数不够，需要查询中的查询，即 subquery 子查询：它利用一个查询的结果于另一个查询中。
步骤：先 SELECT MAX(SCORE) FROM STUDENT 得 89；再 WHERE SCORE = 89 得 Clem；最后把第一个查询放进括号代替 89。内层先执行，结果给外层（主查询）使用；若多人同为最高分，全部都会列出。

Tip：放在比较运算符（=、>、<）后的子查询必须返回单一个值，否则出错。

ex.q: Write a statement to find the names and scores of students who score higher than the average score of all students.
ex.a:
SELECT NAME, SCORE FROM STUDENT
WHERE SCORE > (SELECT AVG(SCORE) FROM STUDENT)
With scores 0, 89, 83, 47, 35, 67, 86 the average is 58.1, so the result is Clem, Eva, Dio, Ben.
ex.az: 子查询求平均分 58.1，主查询找高于平均分的学生：Clem、Eva、Dio、Ben。

cards.en:
✗ Misconception: SELECT NAME, MAX(SCORE) FROM STUDENT can find the name of the student with the highest score.
✓ The NAME returned is not summarised data. The two columns NAME and MAX(SCORE) in the result have no relation. The DBMS simply returns the name of the first student in the table (the book shows Ada, 89, although Ada scored 0).

Only columns with an aggregation function like MAX() contain summarised data. Many DBMS (e.g. MySQL in strict mode) reject this statement altogether.

Correct method: use a subquery,
SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT
WHERE SCORE = (SELECT MAX(SCORE) FROM STUDENT)
or sort and take the first row: SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT ORDER BY SCORE DESC LIMIT 1 (this shows only one student even if there is a tie).
cards.zh:
✗ 误解：SELECT NAME, MAX(SCORE) FROM STUDENT 能找出最高分学生的名字。
✓ 返回的 NAME 不是汇总数据，NAME 与 MAX(SCORE) 两栏没有关系；课本指它只返回表中第一个学生（Ada, 89，但 Ada 其实 0 分）。
Only columns with an aggregation function like MAX() contain summarised data.

正确做法：用子查询 WHERE SCORE = (SELECT MAX(SCORE) …)；或 ORDER BY SCORE DESC LIMIT 1（但同分时只显示一人）。

ex.q: A student writes SELECT CLASS, MIN(SCORE) FROM STUDENT to find the class of the lowest scorer. Explain the problem and correct it.
ex.a:
CLASS is not summarised data; it is not related to MIN(SCORE), so the class shown may not belong to the lowest scorer. Correct:
SELECT CLASS FROM STUDENT
WHERE SCORE = (SELECT MIN(SCORE) FROM STUDENT)
ex.az: CLASS 与 MIN(SCORE) 无关；应用子查询找出分数等于最低分的学生。

cards.t: IN and NOT IN with a subquery
cards.en:
IN is a logical operator which checks for the existence of certain values in other tables. A subquery is sometimes not a must, but it can simplify a statement.
Students who joined at least one club and scored above 70:
SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT
WHERE SCORE > 70 AND SID IN (SELECT SID FROM SC)
Same result as the join SELECT DISTINCT s.NAME FROM STUDENT s, SC WHERE s.SID = SC.SID AND SCORE > 70 (DISTINCT is needed there because Clem has 3 rows in SC). Result: Clem, Eva.

NOT IN checks for the absence of values. Students who joined no club:
SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT WHERE SID NOT IN (SELECT SID FROM SC)
same as SELECT s.NAME FROM STUDENT s LEFT JOIN SC ON s.SID = SC.SID WHERE SC.CID IS NULL → Ben.
Tip: the subquery after IN must return a single list of values, so select only one field in it.
cards.zh:
IN is a logical operator which checks for the existence of certain values in other tables. 子查询有时不是必须，但可以简化语句。参加了学会又高于 70 分的学生：SID IN (SELECT SID FROM SC)，结果与连接 + DISTINCT 相同（Clem 在 SC 有 3 行，连接写法要 DISTINCT）：Clem、Eva。

NOT IN 检查值不存在：没有参加学会的学生 → Ben，与 LEFT JOIN … WHERE SC.CID IS NULL 相同。
Tip：IN 后的子查询必须返回单一列的值，只能 SELECT 一个栏位。

ex.q: PLAYER(ID, NAME), ARMY(ID, OWNER, CID). Rewrite without a join: SELECT p.NAME FROM PLAYER p LEFT JOIN ARMY a ON p.ID = a.OWNER WHERE a.ID IS NULL
ex.a:
SELECT NAME FROM PLAYER WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT OWNER FROM ARMY)
Purpose: list each player who has no army (Checkpoint 3.3(f)).
ex.az: 用途：列出没有军队的玩家；改写为 NOT IN 子查询。

cards.t: Subqueries in INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE
cards.tz: 子查询用于 INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE
cards.en:
A subquery can also help us insert, update and delete data. STUDENT2(ID, NAME, SEX, CLASS, DOB) holds new students.
  • Insert them into STUDENT(SID, NAME, SEX, CLASS, SCORE):
    INSERT INTO STUDENT (SELECT ID, NAME, SEX, CLASS, 0 FROM STUDENT2)
    As long as the number of fields of STUDENT matches the number of fields returned by the subquery, the insertion works; the field names do not have to match. The constant 0 fills SCORE. (In SQLite write it without the parentheses: INSERT INTO STUDENT SELECT …)
  • Update their scores to NULL (no test yet):
    UPDATE STUDENT SET SCORE = NULL
WHERE SID IN (SELECT ID FROM STUDENT2)
  • Delete them:
    DELETE FROM STUDENT WHERE SID IN (SELECT ID FROM STUDENT2)
cards.zh:
子查询也可用于新增、更新和删除数据。
  • 新增：INSERT INTO STUDENT (SELECT ID, NAME, SEX, CLASS, 0 FROM STUDENT2)。只要子查询返回的栏位数目与 STUDENT 相同就可以，栏位名称不必相同；常数 0 填入 SCORE。（SQLite 要去掉括号：INSERT INTO STUDENT SELECT …）
  • 更新：UPDATE STUDENT SET SCORE = NULL WHERE SID IN (SELECT ID FROM STUDENT2)。
  • 删除：DELETE FROM STUDENT WHERE SID IN (SELECT ID FROM STUDENT2)。

ex.q: ORDERS(OID, CID, PAID) and CUSTOMER(CID, NAME, VIP). Write a statement to delete all unpaid orders of customers who are not VIP (VIP = 0).
ex.a:
DELETE FROM ORDERS
WHERE PAID = 0 AND CID IN (SELECT CID FROM CUSTOMER WHERE VIP = 0)
ex.az: 用 IN 子查询找出非 VIP 顾客的 CID，再删除其未付款订单。

cards.en:
EXISTS is a logical operator which checks for the existence of the result of a subquery. It is TRUE if the subquery returns at least one row. Functionally EXISTS is similar to IN; most statements using IN can be rewritten with EXISTS.
Students in STUDENT with the same score as any student in STUDENT2 (scores 83, 47, NULL):
SELECT NAME, SCORE FROM STUDENT s WHERE EXISTS
  (SELECT 1 FROM STUDENT2 s2 WHERE s.SCORE = s2.SCORE)
The subquery refers to s from the outer query, so it is a correlated subquery: it is evaluated once for each row of STUDENT (Ada: no row → FALSE; …; Eva 83: a row → TRUE). Result: Eva 83, Gabe 47.
The 1 can be replaced by 0, any field or any value, because it is not used for comparison or display.
IN version: WHERE SCORE IN (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2) gives exactly the same result.
cards.zh:
EXISTS is a logical operator which checks for the existence of the result of a subquery. 子查询至少返回一行即为 TRUE。功能与 IN 相似，大部分 IN 语句可改写为 EXISTS。
上例的子查询引用外层的 s，是 correlated subquery 相关子查询：对 STUDENT 每一行执行一次（Ada 没有结果 → FALSE；Eva 83 有结果 → TRUE）。结果：Eva、Gabe。
SELECT 1 的 1 可换成 0、任何栏位或值，因为它不用于比较或显示。用 IN 改写结果完全相同。

ex.q: PRODUCT(ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME), REVIEW(ITEM_ID, RATING). State the purpose: SELECT * FROM PRODUCT p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM REVIEW r WHERE r.ITEM_ID = p.ITEM_ID AND r.RATING = 5)
ex.a: It lists (all details of) each product that has received at least one 5-rating review. For each product, the correlated subquery looks for a review of that product with rating 5; EXISTS is TRUE if one is found. (Chapter Exercise Q2(d))
ex.az: 列出至少有一个 5 分评价的产品。

cards.t: NOT EXISTS and the NOT IN NULL trap
cards.tz: NOT EXISTS 与 NOT IN 遇上 NULL
cards.en:
NOT EXISTS checks for the absence of the result of a subquery:
SELECT NAME, SCORE FROM STUDENT s WHERE NOT EXISTS
  (SELECT 1 FROM STUDENT2 s2 WHERE s.SCORE = s2.SCORE)
Result: Ada, Clem, Finn, Dio, Ben.

This is one of the few cases where EXISTS cannot be rewritten using IN. WHERE SCORE NOT IN (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2) becomes SCORE NOT IN (83, 47, NULL) and returns no result:
  • 89 NOT IN (83, 47, NULL) = 89<>83 AND 89<>47 AND 89<>NULL = TRUE AND TRUE AND NULL = NULL (not all TRUE) → row not returned.
  • 83 IN (83, 47, NULL) = 83=83 OR … = TRUE OR … = TRUE (at least one TRUE).
So NULL works normally with IN but not with NOT IN. Fix: use NOT EXISTS, or exclude NULLs: NOT IN (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2 WHERE SCORE IS NOT NULL).
cards.zh:
NOT EXISTS 检查子查询结果不存在，结果：Ada、Clem、Finn、Dio、Ben。

这是少数 EXISTS 不能改写成 IN 的情况：SCORE NOT IN (83, 47, NULL) 没有任何结果：
  • 89 NOT IN (…) = TRUE AND TRUE AND NULL = NULL（不是全部 TRUE），该行不返回。
  • 83 IN (…) = TRUE OR … = TRUE（至少一个 TRUE）。
所以 NULL 对 IN 正常，对 NOT IN 不正常。解决：用 NOT EXISTS，或在子查询加 WHERE SCORE IS NOT NULL。

ex.q: STUDENT2 scores are (83, 47, NULL). How many rows does SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT WHERE SCORE NOT IN (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2) return, and why?
ex.a: 0 rows. For any score x not equal to 83 or 47, x NOT IN (83, 47, NULL) = TRUE AND TRUE AND (x <> NULL = NULL) = NULL, which is not TRUE. For 83 or 47 it is FALSE. So no row qualifies.
ex.az: 0 行：与 NULL 比较得 NULL，AND 之后整体是 NULL 或 FALSE，没有行为 TRUE。

cards.en:
ANY is a logical operator which compares a single value with any of the values in a list. It can be written as SOME. The comparisons are joined by OR.
STUDENT2 classes: 3A, 3B, 3B.
SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT
WHERE CLASS = ANY (SELECT CLASS FROM STUDENT2)
= CLASS = '3A' OR CLASS = '3B' OR CLASS = '3B' → Ada, Clem, Eva, Finn, Ben.

= ANY can be rewritten as IN. But IN cannot always be rewritten as = ANY: IN can be followed by a list of values such as ('3A', '3B'), while = ANY must be followed by a subquery. CLASS = ANY ('3A', '3B') is invalid.

Note: SQLite does not support ANY/ALL; rewrite with IN, MIN() or MAX() when practising there.
cards.zh:
ANY is a logical operator which compares a single value with any of the values in a list. 又写作 SOME；各比较以 OR 连接。
CLASS = ANY (3A, 3B, 3B) = CLASS='3A' OR CLASS='3B' OR … → Ada、Clem、Eva、Finn、Ben。

= ANY 可改写为 IN；但 IN 不一定能改写成 = ANY：IN 后面可接值的列表，而 = ANY 后面必须是子查询（= ANY ('3A', '3B') 不合法）。
注：SQLite 不支援 ANY/ALL，练习时可用 IN、MIN()、MAX() 改写。

ex.q: Rewrite using IN: SELECT NAME FROM CLUB WHERE CID = ANY (SELECT CID FROM SC WHERE SID = '03496')
ex.a:
SELECT NAME FROM CLUB WHERE CID IN (SELECT CID FROM SC WHERE SID = '03496')
Lists Clem's clubs: Chess Club, Art Club, Science Club.
ex.az: = ANY 等同 IN。

cards.en:
With STUDENT2 classes 3A, 3B, 3B:
  • CLASS <> ANY (SELECT CLASS FROM STUDENT2) = CLASS <> '3A' OR CLASS <> '3B' OR CLASS <> '3B'. Since a CLASS value cannot be '3A' and '3B' at the same time, it is always different from at least one of them, so this is TRUE for every student. <> ANY is a meaningless criterion (when the list has two or more different values).
  • CLASS NOT IN (SELECT CLASS FROM STUDENT2) = CLASS <> '3A' AND CLASS <> '3B' → only 3C students (Gabe, Dio). NOT IN actually filters classes.
Remember: ANY ↔ OR, ALL ↔ AND. NOT IN equals <> ALL, not <> ANY.
cards.zh:
STUDENT2 班别为 3A、3B、3B：
  • CLASS <> ANY (…) = CLASS<>'3A' OR CLASS<>'3B'…；一个值不可能同时是 3A 和 3B，总会与其中一个不同，所以对每个学生都成立，是无意义的条件。
  • CLASS NOT IN (…) = CLASS<>'3A' AND CLASS<>'3B' → 只有 3C 学生（Gabe、Dio）。
记住：ANY ↔ OR，ALL ↔ AND；NOT IN 等于 <> ALL，不是 <> ANY。

ex.q: The subquery SELECT CLASS FROM STUDENT2 returns only '3A' (one value). Do <> ANY and NOT IN give the same result now?
ex.a: Yes. With a single value, CLASS <> ANY ('3A') = CLASS <> '3A' = CLASS NOT IN ('3A'). They differ only when the list contains two or more different values.
ex.az: 只有一个值时两者相同；列表有两个或以上不同值时 <> ANY 才变得无意义。

cards.en:
New students' scores: 83, 47, 60.
  • SCORE > ANY (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2) = SCORE > 83 OR SCORE > 47 OR SCORE > 60 = higher than at least one = SCORE > 47 = SCORE > (SELECT MIN(SCORE) FROM STUDENT2). Result: Clem 89, Eva 83, Dio 67, Ben 86.
  • SCORE < ANY (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2) = lower than at least one = SCORE < 83 = < (SELECT MAX(SCORE) …). Result: Ada 0, Gabe 47, Finn 35, Dio 67.
Dio (67) appears in both results: he is higher than Yen (47) and lower than Xing (83).
Shortcut: > ANY ≡ > MIN; < ANY ≡ < MAX.
cards.zh:
新生分数 83、47、60：
  • > ANY = 高于至少一个 = > 47 = > MIN → Clem、Eva、Dio、Ben。
  • < ANY = 低于至少一个 = < 83 = < MAX → Ada、Gabe、Finn、Dio。
Dio (67) 两个结果都有：他高于 Yen (47) 又低于 Xing (83)。
捷径：> ANY ≡ > MIN；< ANY ≡ < MAX。

ex.q: STUDENT2 scores are 55, 72, 90. Which STUDENT scores (0, 89, 83, 47, 35, 67, 86) satisfy SCORE < ANY (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2)?
ex.a: < ANY means < MAX = < 90. All seven scores are below 90, so all 7 students are returned.
ex.az: < ANY 即 < 最大值 90，全部 7 人符合。

cards.en:
✗ Misconception: SELECT NAME, SCORE FROM STUDENT WHERE SCORE > ANY (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2) finds the students who score higher than every new student.
In spoken English, 'Eva's score is higher than any new student' usually means higher than all of them. But in SQL, > ANY means higher than SOME of them, i.e. higher than at least one.
With new scores 83, 47, 60, Yen has the lowest (47), so > ANY means > 47 (Clem, Eva, Dio, Ben), not > 83.

To mean 'higher than all', use > ALL (= > MAX).
Memory aid: read ANY as SOME.
cards.zh:
✗ 误解：SCORE > ANY (…) 找出比所有新生都高分的学生。
日常英语 “higher than any” 通常指高于全部；但 SQL 的 > ANY 是高于其中一些 (SOME)，即至少一个。新生最低分是 Yen 47，所以 > ANY 等于 > 47（Clem、Eva、Dio、Ben），不是 > 83。
要表示“高于全部”用 > ALL（= > MAX）。记法：把 ANY 读作 SOME。

ex.q: A teacher wants students who scored higher than every new student. She writes WHERE SCORE > ANY (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2). Correct it.
ex.a:
SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT
WHERE SCORE > ALL (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2)
or WHERE SCORE > (SELECT MAX(SCORE) FROM STUDENT2). With new scores 83, 47, 60 the result is Clem and Ben.
ex.az: 应用 > ALL 或 > (SELECT MAX…)，结果 Clem、Ben。

cards.en:
ALL is a logical operator which compares a single value with all of the values in a list. The comparisons are joined by AND.
STUDENT2 classes: 3A, 3B, 3B.
SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT
WHERE CLASS <> ALL (SELECT CLASS FROM STUDENT2)
= CLASS <> '3A' AND CLASS <> '3B' AND CLASS <> '3B' → students not in the same class as any new student: Gabe, Dio.

<> ALL can be rewritten as NOT IN. Similar to ANY, ALL must be followed by a subquery: CLASS <> ALL ('3A', '3B') is invalid, while NOT IN ('3A', '3B') is fine.

Chapter Summary example: employees not working on any task: SELECT NAME FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE EID <> ALL (SELECT EID FROM ET).
cards.zh:
ALL is a logical operator which compares a single value with all of the values in a list. 各比较以 AND 连接。
CLASS <> ALL (…) = CLASS<>'3A' AND CLASS<>'3B' → 与所有新生都不同班的学生：Gabe、Dio。
<> ALL 可改写为 NOT IN。与 ANY 一样，ALL 后面必须是子查询，不能接值的列表。
Chapter Summary 例子：没有任何工作的员工 EID <> ALL (SELECT EID FROM ET)。

ex.q: Rewrite with ALL: SELECT NAME FROM PLAYER WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT OWNER FROM ARMY)
ex.a: SELECT NAME FROM PLAYER WHERE ID <> ALL (SELECT OWNER FROM ARMY)
ex.az: NOT IN 等同 <> ALL。

cards.en:
With STUDENT2 classes 3A, 3B, 3B:
  • CLASS = ALL (SELECT CLASS FROM STUDENT2) = CLASS = '3A' AND CLASS = '3B' AND CLASS = '3B'. A value of CLASS cannot be '3A' and '3B' at the same time, so it is like WHERE FALSE: a criterion that is impossible to fulfil. No rows are returned.
  • CLASS IN (SELECT CLASS FROM STUDENT2) = CLASS = '3A' OR CLASS = '3B' → Ada, Clem, Eva, Finn, Ben.
So IN = '= ANY' and NOT IN = '<> ALL'. The pairs '= ALL' and '<> ANY' are usually useless (unless the subquery returns only one distinct value).
cards.zh:
STUDENT2 班别 3A、3B、3B：
  • CLASS = ALL (…) = CLASS='3A' AND CLASS='3B'…，一个值不可能同时等于两个不同的值，相当于 WHERE FALSE，永远不成立，没有结果。
  • CLASS IN (…) = CLASS='3A' OR CLASS='3B' → Ada、Clem、Eva、Finn、Ben。
所以 IN = “= ANY”，NOT IN = “<> ALL”；“= ALL” 和 “<> ANY” 通常没有用（除非子查询只返回一种值）。

ex.q: Match each with its equivalent: (1) = ANY (2) <> ALL (3) > ANY (4) < ALL. Options: NOT IN, IN, > MIN(...), < MIN(...).
ex.a: (1) = ANY ≡ IN; (2) <> ALL ≡ NOT IN; (3) > ANY ≡ > MIN; (4) < ALL ≡ < MIN.
ex.az: = ANY→IN；<> ALL→NOT IN；> ANY→> MIN；< ALL→< MIN。

cards.en:
New students' scores: 83, 47, 60.
  • SCORE > ALL (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2) = SCORE > 83 AND SCORE > 47 AND SCORE > 60 = higher than every new student = SCORE > 83 = SCORE > (SELECT MAX(SCORE) FROM STUDENT2). Result: Clem 89, Ben 86. (Eva 83 is not higher than 83.)
  • SCORE < ALL (SELECT SCORE FROM STUDENT2) = lower than every new student = SCORE < 47 = < MIN. Result: Ada 0, Finn 35. (Gabe 47 is not lower than 47.)
Summary table:
ANY (some)ALL
>> MIN> MAX
<< MAX< MIN
=IN(impossible)
<>(meaningless)NOT IN
cards.zh:
新生分数 83、47、60：
  • > ALL = 高于每一个新生 = > 83 = > MAX → Clem、Ben（Eva 83 不是高于 83）。
  • < ALL = 低于每一个 = < 47 = < MIN → Ada、Finn（Gabe 47 不低于 47）。
总结：> ANY = > MIN；> ALL = > MAX；< ANY = < MAX；< ALL = < MIN；= ANY = IN；<> ALL = NOT IN。

ex.q: PRODUCT(NAME, CATEGORY, PRICE). Write a statement (without ALL) to list products more expensive than every product in the 'Toys' category.
ex.a:
SELECT NAME FROM PRODUCT
WHERE PRICE > (SELECT MAX(PRICE) FROM PRODUCT WHERE CATEGORY = 'Toys')
Equivalent to PRICE > ALL (SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCT WHERE CATEGORY = 'Toys').
ex.az: > ALL 等于 > MAX。

cards.en:
CAT(ID, BID, HID, NAME, AGE, WEIGHT), BREED(ID, NAME, WEIGHT), HOTEL(ID, NAME, CAPACITY). Task: list the name of each cat breed in the hotel named Alpha.
  • Join, no subquery (DISTINCT removes duplications):
    SELECT DISTINCT b.NAME FROM CAT c, BREED b, HOTEL h
WHERE BID = b.ID AND HID = h.ID AND h.NAME = 'Alpha'
  • IN:
    SELECT NAME FROM BREED WHERE ID IN
  (SELECT BID FROM CAT, HOTEL h WHERE HID = h.ID AND h.NAME = 'Alpha')
    We still join tables inside the subquery (unless we nest another subquery).
  • = ANY: WHERE ID = ANY (SELECT BID FROM …)
  • EXISTS:
    SELECT NAME FROM BREED b WHERE EXISTS
  (SELECT BID FROM CAT c, HOTEL h
   WHERE BID = b.ID AND HID = h.ID AND h.NAME = 'Alpha')
The subquery versions need no DISTINCT, because each BREED row is tested once.
cards.zh:
Example 3.3(a)：列出 Alpha 酒店内猫的品种名称，有多种写法：
  • 连接（要 DISTINCT 去重）；
  • IN 子查询（子查询内仍要连接 CAT 和 HOTEL）；
  • = ANY；
  • EXISTS（相关子查询，条件 BID = b.ID）。
子查询写法不需要 DISTINCT，因为每个 BREED 行只被检查一次。

ex.q: Why does the join version need DISTINCT but the IN version does not?
ex.a: In the join version each cat produces a row, so if Alpha has 3 Ragdoll cats, 'Ragdoll' appears 3 times. In the IN version, the main query reads each BREED row once and only tests whether its ID is in the list, so each breed name appears at most once.
ex.az: 连接时每只猫产生一行，品种会重复；IN 写法每个品种只检查一次。

cards.t: The main query cannot retrieve data from a subquery
cards.tz: 主查询不能取用子查询的栏位
cards.en:
✗ This statement results in errors:
SELECT NAME, h.NAME FROM BREED WHERE ID IN
  (SELECT BID FROM CAT, HOTEL h WHERE HID = h.ID AND h.NAME = 'Alpha')
The main query cannot retrieve data from the subquery. The alias h exists only inside the subquery; the main query only has BREED.
Because the main query has only one table (BREED), we do not need to specify which table NAME comes from: NAME must come from BREED.

If you need fields from several tables in the output, you must join those tables in the main query (or create a view). A subquery only supplies values for filtering (or a single computed value).
The opposite direction is allowed: a correlated subquery can use fields of the outer query (e.g. b.ID).
cards.zh:
✗ 上面的语句会出错：The main query cannot retrieve data from the subquery. 别名 h 只存在于子查询内，主查询只有 BREED。
主查询只有一个表，所以 NAME 一定来自 BREED，不用注明表名。

输出若需要多个表的栏位，必须在主查询中连接这些表；子查询只提供筛选用的值。
反方向可以：相关子查询可以使用外层查询的栏位（如 b.ID）。

ex.q: A student wants each cat's name and its hotel's name, and writes SELECT NAME, HNAME FROM CAT WHERE HID IN (SELECT ID AS HNAME FROM HOTEL). Fix it.
ex.a:
The main query cannot take HNAME from the subquery. Join instead:
SELECT c.NAME, h.NAME AS HNAME
FROM CAT c, HOTEL h WHERE c.HID = h.ID
ex.az: 主查询不能取子查询栏位，应改用连接。

cards.t: Correlated subqueries: comparing with the outer row
cards.tz: 相关子查询：与外层记录比较
cards.en:
A correlated subquery refers to the outer query's table, so it is evaluated for each outer row. Example 3.3:
  • (b) cats in hotel Beta lighter than their breed's global average weight. Simpler by joining:
    SELECT c.NAME FROM CAT c, BREED b, HOTEL h
WHERE BID = b.ID AND HID = h.ID AND h.NAME = 'Beta'
  AND c.WEIGHT < b.WEIGHT
    Tip: sometimes it is simpler to join tables without subquery.
  • (c) hotels with more cats than capacity, without GROUP BY:
    SELECT NAME FROM HOTEL h WHERE
  (SELECT COUNT(c.ID) FROM CAT c WHERE HID = h.ID) > CAPACITY
    (join version: GROUP BY HID HAVING COUNT(c.ID) > AVG(CAPACITY)).
  • (d) Ragdoll cats older than the average Ragdoll age:
    SELECT c.NAME FROM CAT c, BREED b
WHERE BID = b.ID AND b.NAME = 'Ragdoll'
  AND AGE > (SELECT AVG(c2.AGE) FROM CAT c2 WHERE c2.BID = b.ID)
    Use a second alias (c2) for the same table inside the subquery.
cards.zh:
相关子查询引用外层的表，对外层每一行计算一次。Example 3.3：
  • (b) Beta 酒店里比品种平均体重轻的猫：直接连接更简单。Tip：有时不用子查询、直接连接更简单。
  • (c) 猫数超过容量的酒店：子查询 (SELECT COUNT(c.ID) FROM CAT c WHERE HID = h.ID) > CAPACITY，不用 GROUP BY。
  • (d) 比 Ragdoll 平均年龄大的 Ragdoll 猫：子查询中同一表用第二个别名 c2。

ex.q: PRODUCT(ITEM_NAME, CATEGORY, QUANTITY). List each product whose quantity is greater than the average quantity of its own category (Chapter Exercise Q2(a)).
ex.a:
SELECT ITEM_NAME FROM PRODUCT p
WHERE QUANTITY >
  (SELECT AVG(QUANTITY) FROM PRODUCT p2 WHERE p2.CATEGORY = p.CATEGORY)
The subquery is correlated: for each product p, it computes the average of p's own category.
ex.az: 相关子查询：对每件产品计算其所属类别的平均数量。

cards.t: 'Does not have': use NOT IN, not <>
cards.en:
Example 3.3(e): list each hotel that does not have any Ragdoll cats.
✓ Correct:
SELECT NAME FROM HOTEL WHERE ID NOT IN
  (SELECT HID FROM CAT, BREED b WHERE BID = b.ID AND b.NAME = 'Ragdoll')
First find hotels that do have Ragdolls, then take the rest.
✗ Wrong:
SELECT NAME FROM HOTEL WHERE ID IN
  (SELECT HID FROM CAT, BREED b WHERE BID = b.ID AND b.NAME <> 'Ragdoll')
This lists hotels with at least one non-Ragdoll cat. Such hotels may also have Ragdoll cats, and hotels with no cats at all are not included.

Same idea in Example 3.4: 'in football but not in relay race' must not be computed as 'not in relay race', because some participants joined no event.
cards.zh:
Example 3.3(e)：列出没有 Ragdoll 猫的酒店。
✓ 正确：先找出有 Ragdoll 的酒店，再用 NOT IN 取其余。
✗ 错误：ID IN (… b.NAME <> 'Ragdoll')：这是“至少有一只非 Ragdoll 猫的酒店”，这些酒店可能也有 Ragdoll，而且完全没有猫的酒店不会出现。

Example 3.4 同理：“参加足球但不参加接力”不能写成“不参加接力”，因为有人两项都没参加。

ex.q: CUSTOMER(CID, NAME), ORDERS(OID, CID, ITEM). List customers who have never ordered 'Pizza'.
ex.a:
SELECT NAME FROM CUSTOMER WHERE CID NOT IN
  (SELECT CID FROM ORDERS WHERE ITEM = 'Pizza')
Using CID IN (SELECT CID FROM ORDERS WHERE ITEM <> 'Pizza') would be wrong: it includes customers who ordered pizza plus other items, and misses customers with no orders.
ex.az: 先找订过 Pizza 的顾客，再 NOT IN。

cards.en:
Example 3.3(f): state the purpose of
SELECT h.NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.BID) FROM HOTEL h
  LEFT JOIN CAT c ON h.ID = c.HID GROUP BY h.ID
  • LEFT JOIN with HOTEL as the left table → every hotel is listed, including hotels with no cats.
  • DISTINCT c.BID → the same breed is counted once per hotel.
  • A hotel with no cats has BID = NULL; COUNT ignores NULL, giving 0.
Purpose: it counts the number of (different) cat breeds within each hotel.
E.g. HOTEL1 breeds 1, 2, 2, 3 → 3; HOTEL2 breeds 1, 3, 3 → 2; HOTEL3 none → 0.
cards.zh:
Example 3.3(f)：
  • HOTEL 作左表的 LEFT JOIN → 列出每一间酒店，包括没有猫的。
  • DISTINCT c.BID → 同一品种在同一酒店只计一次。
  • 没有猫的酒店 BID 为 NULL，COUNT 不计 NULL，得 0。
用途：计算每间酒店内猫的（不同）品种数目。例：HOTEL1 品种 1,2,2,3 → 3；HOTEL2 → 2；HOTEL3 → 0。

ex.q: Using STUDENT(SID, CLASS) and SC(SID, CID), write a statement to count the number of different clubs joined by students of each class.
ex.a:
SELECT CLASS, COUNT(DISTINCT CID) FROM STUDENT s
  LEFT JOIN SC ON s.SID = SC.SID
GROUP BY CLASS
DISTINCT prevents a club joined by two students of the same class being counted twice.
ex.az: 用 COUNT(DISTINCT CID)，避免同班两人参加同一学会被重复计算。

cards.t: Join vs subquery: rewriting between them
cards.tz: 连接与子查询互相改写
cards.en:
Many tasks can be done either by joining or by a subquery:
NeedJoin versionSubquery version
records that have a matchINNER JOIN / equi-join (+ DISTINCT)IN / EXISTS / = ANY
records with no matchLEFT JOIN … WHERE other.key IS NULLNOT IN / NOT EXISTS / <> ALL
compare with a summary value(GROUP BY … HAVING)= / > (SELECT MAX/AVG …)
Choosing:
  • If the output needs fields from several tables, you must join (the main query cannot read subquery fields).
  • If a table is only used for checking, a subquery is often clearer and avoids duplicates.
  • Beware NULL with NOT IN; NOT EXISTS is safer.
cards.zh:
很多题目既可用连接也可用子查询：有配对 → INNER JOIN（+DISTINCT）或 IN/EXISTS/= ANY；没有配对 → LEFT JOIN … IS NULL 或 NOT IN/NOT EXISTS/<> ALL；与汇总值比较 → 子查询 (SELECT MAX/AVG…)。
  • 输出需要多个表的栏位 → 必须连接。
  • 某表只用来检查 → 子查询较清楚，也避免重复。
  • NOT IN 遇 NULL 要小心，NOT EXISTS 较安全。

ex.q: STUDENT(STU_ID, NAME), GRADE(SUBJECT, STU_ID, SCORE). Some students have no record in GRADE. (i) List them with LEFT JOIN. (ii) Rewrite using EXISTS. (Chapter Exercise Q3(b)(c))
ex.a:
(i)
SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT s LEFT JOIN GRADE g
  ON s.STU_ID = g.STU_ID WHERE g.STU_ID IS NULL
(ii)
SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT s WHERE NOT EXISTS
  (SELECT 1 FROM GRADE g WHERE g.STU_ID = s.STU_ID)
ex.az: (i) LEFT JOIN 后找 IS NULL；(ii) 改用 NOT EXISTS 相关子查询。

cards.en:
Sometimes we want to combine the results from two queries. Set operators do this: UNION, UNION ALL, INTERSECT, EXCEPT (MINUS).
STUDENT(SID, NAME, …) has 7 students; STUDENT2(STUDENTID, NAME, …) has 4 new students (03517 Benz, 03518 Xing, 03519 Yen, 03520 Zack). 03517 appears in both tables.
SELECT SID FROM STUDENT UNION SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2
UNION returns all rows from both results and removes duplicated rows, as if DISTINCT is used. Result: 10 rows (03517 once).

Rules:
  • The number of fields in both results must match; the field names do not have to.
  • The combined result uses the field names of the first result (SID).
cards.zh:
有时要合并两个查询的结果，就用集合运算符：UNION、UNION ALL、INTERSECT、EXCEPT (MINUS)。
STUDENT 有 7 人，STUDENT2 有 4 名新生，03517 两表都有。
UNION 返回两个结果的所有行，并删除重复行（如同 DISTINCT），结果 10 行，03517 只出现一次。
规则：
  • 两个结果的栏位数目必须相同，栏位名不用相同。
  • 合并结果采用第一个结果的栏位名 (SID)。

ex.q: STUDENT has SIDs 03493, 03496, 03505, 03506, 03510, 03513, 03517; STUDENT2 has 03517, 03518, 03519, 03520. How many rows does SELECT SID FROM STUDENT UNION SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2 return?
ex.a: 7 + 4 = 11 rows before removing duplicates; 03517 is in both, so UNION returns 10 rows.
ex.az: 共 11 行，删去重复的 03517，得 10 行。

cards.t: UNION removes only completely identical rows
cards.tz: UNION 只删除完全相同的行
cards.en:
Only rows with completely identical data are removed. If we also select NAME:
SELECT SID, NAME FROM STUDENT
UNION
SELECT STUDENTID, NAME FROM STUDENT2
(03517, Ben) and (03517, Benz) are different rows, so both are shown: 11 rows.

Also, it does not matter whether field names match, but if both results store different kinds of data, the combined result may not be meaningful:
SELECT DOB FROM STUDENT2 UNION SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2
runs, but mixes dates and identity codes in one column. Make sure corresponding fields have the same meaning.
cards.zh:
Only rows with completely identical data are removed. 同时选 SID 和 NAME 时，(03517, Ben) 与 (03517, Benz) 是不同的行，两行都保留，共 11 行。

栏位名不用相同，但若两边储存不同种类的数据（如 DOB UNION STUDENTID），语句可执行，结果却没有意义。对应的栏位应该有相同意义。

ex.q: Table A has rows (1,'x'), (2,'y'); table B has rows (2,'y'), (2,'z'). How many rows does SELECT * FROM A UNION SELECT * FROM B return?
ex.a: Rows: (1,x), (2,y), (2,y), (2,z). Only (2,y) is completely identical twice, so it is kept once: 3 rows.
ex.az: 只有 (2,y) 完全相同，删去一次，得 3 行。

cards.t: WHERE and ORDER BY in combined results
cards.tz: 合并结果中的 WHERE 与 ORDER BY
cards.en:
Each SELECT has its own WHERE clause; they do not share it:
SELECT SID FROM STUDENT
UNION
SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2 WHERE CLASS = '3B'
Here WHERE filters only STUDENT2; all STUDENT rows are kept. To filter STUDENT too, add a WHERE after its SELECT.
✗ (SELECT PID FROM FOOTBALL UNION SELECT PID FROM RELAYRACE) WHERE TEAM = 'A' is wrong: a WHERE clause cannot be shared between two SELECT clauses.

ORDER BY applies to the whole combined result, so it must be placed at the end, never in the middle:
SELECT SID FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS = '3A'
UNION
SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2 WHERE CLASS = '3B'
ORDER BY SID
Because the second result's field names are not carried to the combined result, use the first result's field name: ORDER BY SID, not ORDER BY STUDENTID.
cards.zh:
每个 SELECT 有自己的 WHERE，不会共用。上例 WHERE 只过滤 STUDENT2，STUDENT 全部保留。✗ 把 WHERE 放在整个 UNION 之后是错的：WHERE clause cannot be shared between two SELECT clauses。

ORDER BY 作用于整个合并结果，只能放在最后，不能放在中间；而且要用第一个结果的栏位名（ORDER BY SID，不是 STUDENTID）。

ex.q: Correct this statement: SELECT BIB FROM FOOTBALL ORDER BY BIB UNION ALL SELECT BIB FROM RELAYRACE ORDER BY BIB
ex.a:
SELECT BIB FROM FOOTBALL
UNION ALL
SELECT BIB FROM RELAYRACE
ORDER BY BIB
ORDER BY cannot be placed in the middle of a statement; one ORDER BY at the end sorts the whole result.
ex.az: ORDER BY 只能放在最后一次。

cards.tz: 连接表与合并结果的分别
cards.en:
Do not mix up these two actions:
Joining tables (JOIN)Combining results (UNION etc.)
PurposeMatches values in specific fields to link related data from tables storing different kinds of dataStacks results that store the same kind of data
DirectionAdds columns (side by side)Adds rows (one below another)
RequirementA field to match on (foreign key), except CROSS JOINEqual numbers of fields
ExampleCITY JOIN COUNTRY on CC → each city with its country nameCITY UNION CITY2 → a larger list of cities
cards.zh: 不要混淆：连接 (join) 按指定栏位的值配对，连接存放不同种类数据的相关表，结果增加栏（左右并排），例如 CITY 连接 COUNTRY 得出每个城市的国家名称。合并 (combine) 把储存同类数据、栏位数目相同的结果上下叠起来，结果增加行，例如 CITY UNION CITY2 得出更长的城市列表。

ex.q: SCHOOL_A_STAFF(NAME, PHONE) and SCHOOL_B_STAFF(NAME, PHONE). Should we JOIN or UNION to make one phone list of all staff? Write it.
ex.a:
Both store the same kind of data with the same number of fields, so combine them:
SELECT NAME, PHONE FROM SCHOOL_A_STAFF
UNION
SELECT NAME, PHONE FROM SCHOOL_B_STAFF
ex.az: 同类数据、栏位数相同 → 用 UNION 合并。

cards.en:
UNION removes duplicated rows. To keep duplicated rows, use UNION ALL:
SELECT SID FROM STUDENT UNION ALL SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2
03517 exists in both tables, so it is shown twice: 11 rows.

When to use:
  • UNION ALL is used instead of UNION when the number of occurrences of values matters (e.g. list every bib number as many times as it appears, then count).
  • UNION ALL performs better than UNION, since it does not compare rows to find duplicates.
cards.zh:
UNION 会删除重复行；要保留重复行就用 UNION ALL。03517 两表都有，所以出现两次，共 11 行。
  • 当值出现的次数重要时用 UNION ALL（例如列出每个号码的所有出现次数）。
  • UNION ALL 比 UNION 快，因为不用比较各行找重复。

ex.q: FOOTBALL bibs: 7, 9, 12. RELAYRACE bibs: 9, 12, 12. What do UNION and UNION ALL return (sorted)?
ex.a: UNION: 7, 9, 12 (3 rows). UNION ALL: 7, 9, 9, 12, 12, 12 (6 rows).
ex.az: UNION 得 7, 9, 12；UNION ALL 得 7, 9, 9, 12, 12, 12。

cards.en:
INTERSECT returns only the rows that exist in both results.
SELECT SID FROM STUDENT INTERSECT SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2
Result: 03517.
As with other set operators, only rows with completely identical data count as the same. If NAME is also selected:
SELECT SID, NAME FROM STUDENT
INTERSECT
SELECT STUDENTID, NAME FROM STUDENT2
returns an empty set, because (03517, Ben) ≠ (03517, Benz).

INTERSECT can be rewritten with IN: SELECT SID FROM STUDENT WHERE SID IN (SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2). (Note: MySQL supports INTERSECT and EXCEPT only from version 8.0.31; SQLite supports them.)
cards.zh:
INTERSECT returns only the rows that exist in both results. 结果：03517。
同样只有完全相同的行才算相同；同时选 NAME 时 (03517, Ben) 与 (03517, Benz) 不同，结果是空集 (empty set)。

INTERSECT 可用 IN 改写。（MySQL 8.0.31 起才支援 INTERSECT/EXCEPT；SQLite 支援。）

ex.q: Using FOOTBALL(PID, …) and RELAYRACE(PID, …), list the PIDs of participants in both events.
ex.a:
SELECT PID FROM FOOTBALL
INTERSECT
SELECT PID FROM RELAYRACE
ex.az: 两项都参加 → INTERSECT。

cards.en:
EXCEPT returns the rows from the first result excluding those which also exist in the second result. Sometimes it is written as MINUS (e.g. Oracle).
SELECT SID FROM STUDENT EXCEPT SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2
Result: 03493, 03496, 03505, 03506, 03510, 03513 (03517 removed).
Order matters: A EXCEPT B ≠ B EXCEPT A. SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2 EXCEPT SELECT SID FROM STUDENT gives 03518, 03519, 03520.
Only completely identical rows are excluded: with SID, NAME selected, (03517, Ben) is not excluded because the second result has (03517, Benz).
Equivalent with NOT IN: SELECT SID FROM STUDENT WHERE SID NOT IN (SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2).
cards.zh:
EXCEPT returns the rows from the first result excluding those which also exist in the second result. 有时写作 MINUS。结果：STUDENT 中除 03517 以外的 6 个 SID。
次序重要：A EXCEPT B ≠ B EXCEPT A（STUDENT2 EXCEPT STUDENT 得 03518、03519、03520）。
只排除完全相同的行：选 SID, NAME 时 (03517, Ben) 不会被排除。可用 NOT IN 改写。

ex.q: HBS(ISBN, PRICE) and WBS(ISBN, PRICE) are two bookstores. List the ISBN of each book priced below $100 in World Bookstore but not available in Hello Bookstore (Checkpoint 3.4(a)).
ex.a:
SELECT ISBN FROM WBS WHERE PRICE < 100
EXCEPT
SELECT ISBN FROM HBS
ex.az: WBS 中价钱低于 100 的 ISBN，EXCEPT 掉 HBS 有的。

cards.t: Summary of the four set operators
cards.en:
OperatorReturnsDuplicates
UNIONrows in A or Bremoved
UNION ALLall rows of A then Bkept
INTERSECTrows in both A and Bremoved
EXCEPT / MINUSrows in A but not in Bremoved
Common rules:
  • Same number of fields; field names from the first result.
  • Rows must be completely identical to be treated as the same.
  • Each SELECT has its own WHERE; ORDER BY only once at the end.
  • Set operators can be used inside a subquery, e.g. ID IN (SELECT PID FROM FOOTBALL EXCEPT SELECT PID FROM RELAYRACE).
cards.zh:
UNION：A 或 B 的行，去重；UNION ALL：全部行，保留重复；INTERSECT：A 和 B 都有的行；EXCEPT/MINUS：A 有而 B 没有的行。
共同规则：栏位数相同；完全相同的行才算相同；各 SELECT 有自己的 WHERE；ORDER BY 只在最后；集合运算可以放在子查询里。

ex.q: S1 = {1, 2, 3, 4}, S2 = {3, 4, 5}. Give the result of S1 UNION S2, S1 UNION ALL S2, S1 INTERSECT S2, S1 EXCEPT S2 and S2 EXCEPT S1.
ex.a: UNION: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. UNION ALL: 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 4, 5 (7 rows). INTERSECT: 3, 4. S1 EXCEPT S2: 1, 2. S2 EXCEPT S1: 5.
ex.az: 按定义逐一计算。

cards.t: Enrichment: selecting data from results; several set operators
cards.tz: Enrichment：从结果中再选取；多个集合运算符
cards.en:
To analyse a combined or summarised result, treat the result as a table by giving it an alias, then select from it just like a subquery:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
  (SELECT SID FROM STUDENT UNION SELECT STUDENTID FROM STUDENT2) u
→ 10 students with unique identity codes. (u is the alias; MySQL requires it.)
✗ SELECT COUNT(SID) FROM STUDENT UNION SELECT COUNT(STUDENTID) FROM STUDENT2 does not work as intended: it returns two rows, 7 and 4.

A statement may include more than one set operator:
SELECT SID FROM S1 INTERSECT
SELECT SID FROM S2 INTERSECT
SELECT SID FROM S3
returns the values common to all three results. Operators can also be mixed, e.g. SELECT ISBN FROM HBS UNION SELECT ISBN FROM WBS EXCEPT SELECT ISBN FROM BOOK (evaluated left to right in SQLite).
cards.zh:
要分析合并或汇总后的结果，可把结果当作表并给它别名，再像子查询一样 SELECT：COUNT(*) FROM (… UNION …) u → 10。✗ 分别 COUNT 再 UNION 会得到两行 7 和 4，不是想要的。

一句可以有多个集合运算符：S1 INTERSECT S2 INTERSECT S3 得三者共有的值；也可混用，例如 HBS UNION WBS EXCEPT BOOK（SQLite 由左至右计算）。

ex.q: Some books in HBS or WBS have no record in BOOK (Checkpoint 3.4(d)). List their ISBNs using set operators only.
ex.a:
SELECT ISBN FROM HBS
UNION
SELECT ISBN FROM WBS
EXCEPT
SELECT ISBN FROM BOOK
First all ISBNs sold in either store, then remove those in BOOK. Alternative: each store's ISBN NOT IN (SELECT ISBN FROM BOOK), combined with UNION.
ex.az: 先 UNION 两店的 ISBN，再 EXCEPT 掉 BOOK 的 ISBN。

cards.en:
PARTICIPANT(ID, NAME, GENDER, AGE), FOOTBALL(ID, PID, BIB, TEAM), RELAYRACE(ID, PID, BIB, TEAM). Some participants have not decided on any event.
  • (a) every occurrence of each bib number, sorted → UNION ALL, ORDER BY at the end:
    SELECT BIB FROM FOOTBALL UNION ALL SELECT BIB FROM RELAYRACE ORDER BY BIB
  • (b) participants in team 'A' in at least one event → UNION (not INTERSECT), one WHERE per SELECT:
    SELECT PID FROM FOOTBALL WHERE TEAM = 'A'
UNION SELECT PID FROM RELAYRACE WHERE TEAM = 'A'
  • (c) female participants in football but not relay race → EXCEPT inside a subquery:
    SELECT NAME FROM PARTICIPANT WHERE GENDER = 'F' AND ID IN
  (SELECT PID FROM FOOTBALL EXCEPT SELECT PID FROM RELAYRACE)
  • (d) at least 22 and not in both events at the same time:
    SELECT NAME FROM PARTICIPANT WHERE AGE >= 22 AND ID NOT IN
  (SELECT PID FROM FOOTBALL INTERSECT SELECT PID FROM RELAYRACE)
    'Not in both at the same time' ≠ 'not in any of the two events'.
cards.zh:
• (a) 每个号码的每次出现 → UNION ALL，ORDER BY 放最后。
  • (b) 至少一项属于 A 队 → UNION（不是 INTERSECT），每个 SELECT 各有 WHERE。
  • (c) 参加足球但不参加接力的女生 → 子查询内用 EXCEPT；不能只排除接力参加者，因为有人两项都没参加。
  • (d) 22 岁或以上而不是同时参加两项 → NOT IN (… INTERSECT …)。“不同时参加两项” ≠ “两项都不参加”。

ex.q: Using the Example 3.4 tables, list the names of participants who have joined neither event.
ex.a:
SELECT NAME FROM PARTICIPANT WHERE ID NOT IN
  (SELECT PID FROM FOOTBALL UNION SELECT PID FROM RELAYRACE)
ex.az: 先 UNION 两项的参加者，再 NOT IN。

cards.en:
In programming, code that is reused frequently is put in a sub-program (e.g. a Python function def sum(first, last, diff)) to make the program more readable and easier to modify.
Similarly, in a database, when we expect a certain result of a SQL statement to be reused frequently in summarisation or as a subquery, we create a view, which works as a virtual table, to simplify future SQL statements.

A view is defined by a SELECT statement. Querying the view (SELECT * FROM SCORESHEET) returns exactly the same result as running its defining SELECT. The view itself does not store data; it always reads the current data of the tables it refers to.
cards.zh:
编程时，常重用的代码会写成子程序 (sub-program)，令程序更易读、易改。
数据库也一样：预计某个 SQL 结果会经常重用（用于汇总或作子查询）时，就建立 view，它像一个虚拟表 (virtual table)，可以简化以后的 SQL。

View 由一句 SELECT 定义；查询 view 的结果与执行该 SELECT 完全相同。View 本身不储存数据，永远读取所引用表的最新数据。

ex.q: Give two reasons for creating a view in a school database that is often queried for students' final scores with class teacher names.
ex.a: (1) It shows frequently retrieved data (final score + teacher) without rewriting the join and formula each time. (2) It simplifies later SQL statements, e.g. SELECT NAME FROM SCORESHEET WHERE FSCORE < 60, reducing errors.
ex.az: 显示常用数据；简化之后的 SQL。

cards.tz: 没有 view 时的复杂查询
cards.en:
Tables: STUDENT(SID, NAME, SEX, CLASS, SCORE1, SCORE2), SC(SID, CID), CLUB(CID, NAME), CLASS(CLASS, TEACH, LANG). Final score = SCORE1 × 0.4 + SCORE2 × 0.6.
  1. Taught by Mr Suen with final score below 60:
    SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT s, CLASS cl WHERE s.CLASS = cl.CLASS
  AND TEACH = 'Mr Suen' AND SCORE1 * 0.4 + SCORE2 * 0.6 < 60
    → Dio.
  2. Joins at least two clubs and final score above 60:
    SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT WHERE SCORE1 * 0.4 + SCORE2 * 0.6 > 60
  AND SID IN (SELECT SID FROM SC GROUP BY SID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)
    → Hans, Jean, Clem, Eva, Gabe.
  3. Class language Chinese and joins no club besides English Club: join STUDENT–CLASS and use SID IN (… English Club … INTERSECT SELECT SID FROM SC GROUP BY SID HAVING COUNT(CID) = 1) → Ben.
  4. Joins the most clubs: needs a nested aggregate (see next card).
The same join and formula are written again and again. This is why views help.
cards.zh:
上例四个任务都要重复写 STUDENT–CLASS 连接和最终分数公式，或在子查询中 GROUP BY 计算学会数目：
  1. Mr Suen 教、最终分数低于 60 → Dio。
  2. 参加至少两个学会、最终分数高于 60 → Hans、Jean、Clem、Eva、Gabe。
  3. 中文授课班、除 English Club 外没参加其他学会 → Ben（用 INTERSECT）。
  4. 参加最多学会的学生：需要嵌套聚合。
同样的连接和公式不断重写，所以 view 很有用。

ex.q: Hans has SCORE1 82 and SCORE2 67. Ivy has 65 and 56. Compute their final scores.
ex.az: Hans 73，Ivy 59.6。

cards.en:
In most DBMS, an aggregation function cannot summarise the data of another aggregation function directly: SELECT MAX(COUNT(*)) FROM SC GROUP BY SID results in an error.
Method 1: treat the aggregated result as a table (with an alias):
SELECT MAX(TOTAL) FROM
  (SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM SC GROUP BY SID) t
→ 4.
Method 2: sort and take the first row with LIMIT:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM SC
GROUP BY SID ORDER BY TOTAL DESC LIMIT 1
Then the students who join the most clubs:
SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT s LEFT JOIN SC ON s.SID = SC.SID
GROUP BY s.SID
HAVING COUNT(CID) = (SELECT MAX(TOTAL) FROM
  (SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM SC GROUP BY SID) t)
→ Hans, Clem. It works but is complex; a view makes it much simpler.
cards.zh:
大多数 DBMS 中，聚合函数不能直接汇总另一个聚合函数的结果，MAX(COUNT(*)) 会出错。
方法一：把汇总结果当作表并给别名，再 SELECT MAX(TOTAL)；方法二：ORDER BY TOTAL DESC LIMIT 1。
找参加最多学会的学生：HAVING COUNT(CID) = (上述最大值) → Hans、Clem。可行但复杂，用 view 会简单得多。

ex.q: Using GRADE(SUBJECT, STU_ID, SCORE), find the highest average score among all students (one number).
ex.a:
SELECT MAX(AVGS) FROM
  (SELECT AVG(SCORE) AS AVGS FROM GRADE GROUP BY STU_ID) t
MAX(AVG(SCORE)) is not allowed directly, so the per-student averages are treated as a table t.
ex.az: 不能写 MAX(AVG())，要把每人平均当作表再取 MAX。

cards.en:
CREATE VIEW SCORESHEET AS
  SELECT s.SID, NAME, SEX, s.CLASS, TEACH, LANG,
         SCORE1*0.4+SCORE2*0.6 AS FSCORE
  FROM STUDENT s, CLASS cl WHERE s.CLASS = cl.CLASS
Syntax: CREATE VIEW view_name AS SELECT …
SELECT * FROM SCORESHEET returns exactly the same result as running the SELECT part.
Remember to give aliases to every summarised/calculated field, like COUNT(*) or SCORE1*0.4+SCORE2*0.6 (here FSCORE). Otherwise it is hard to select them.
Now task 1 becomes
SELECT NAME FROM SCORESHEET WHERE TEACH = 'Mr Suen' AND FSCORE < 60
Since we expect to frequently join STUDENT and CLASS and calculate final scores, the view does both already.
cards.zh:
语法：CREATE VIEW 视图名 AS SELECT …。SELECT * FROM SCORESHEET 的结果与执行该 SELECT 完全相同。
记得给每个汇总/计算栏位起别名（如 COUNT(*)、SCORE1*0.4+SCORE2*0.6 AS FSCORE），否则之后很难选取。
任务 1 变成 SELECT NAME FROM SCORESHEET WHERE TEACH = 'Mr Suen' AND FSCORE < 60。

ex.q: CUSTOMER(CID, CNAME), MEAL(MID, MNAME, OPRICE, DISCOUNT), FORDER(CID, MID, NUM, ETA, PAID). Create view FORDER2 showing CID, MID, MNAME, total price TPRICE = OPRICE × (1 − DISCOUNT) × NUM, and ETA (Checkpoint 3.5(a)).
ex.a:
CREATE VIEW FORDER2 AS
  SELECT CID, f.MID, MNAME, OPRICE*(1-DISCOUNT)*NUM AS TPRICE, ETA
  FROM FORDER f, MEAL m WHERE f.MID = m.MID
ex.az: 连接 FORDER 和 MEAL，计算栏位要起别名 TPRICE。

cards.t: A view does not store data: no manual updates
cards.tz: View 不储存数据，不需手动更新
cards.en:
Hans appeals and his SCORE2 increases by 10, so his final score changes from 73 to 79. After updating STUDENT, do we need to update SCORESHEET too?
No, we do not, and we should not. A view always refers to data from other tables. It does not store data of its own. We do not need to update a view, nor should we update a view manually.
✓ UPDATE STUDENT SET SCORE2 = SCORE2 + 10 WHERE SID = '03369'
✗ UPDATE SCORESHEET SET FSCORE = FSCORE + 10 * 0.6 WHERE SID = '03369' (FSCORE is calculated; such views cannot be updated)

The next SELECT * FROM SCORESHEET automatically shows 79. This avoids data inconsistency: there is only one copy of the data.
cards.zh:
Hans 的 SCORE2 加 10 分，最终分数由 73 变 79。更新 STUDENT 后要不要更新 SCORESHEET？
不需要，也不应该。A view always refers to data from other tables. It does not store data of its own.
✓ 只更新 STUDENT；✗ 不要 UPDATE SCORESHEET（FSCORE 是计算出来的）。之后查询 view 自动显示 79。数据只有一份，避免 data inconsistency。

ex.q: A student says: 'After creating a view, we must refresh it whenever the base table changes.' Is this correct?
ex.a: No. A view does not store its own data; every time it is queried, its defining SELECT runs on the current data of the base tables. Changes in the base tables are reflected automatically.
ex.az: 错。View 不储存数据，每次查询都读取表的最新数据。

cards.t: Views can miss records: COUNTCLUB and Dio
cards.tz: View 可能遗漏记录：COUNTCLUB 与 Dio
cards.en:
CREATE VIEW COUNTCLUB AS
  SELECT SID, COUNT(*) AS CLUBNUM FROM SC GROUP BY SID
Task 2 becomes SELECT NAME FROM SCORESHEET WHERE FSCORE > 60 AND SID IN (SELECT SID FROM COUNTCLUB WHERE CLUBNUM >= 2) → Hans, Jean, Clem, Eva, Gabe.

Problem: Dio (03513) joins no club, so his SID is not in SC and therefore not even in the view. For 'joins no more than two clubs' (CLUBNUM <= 2), Dio is wrongly missed (result: Jean, Eva, Ben, without Dio).
Fix: build the view with an outer join from STUDENT so that every student appears, and count a field that is NULL for no match:
SELECT s.SID, COUNT(CID) AS CLUBNUM FROM STUDENT s
  LEFT JOIN SC ON SC.SID = s.SID GROUP BY s.SID
Use COUNT(CID), not COUNT(*); otherwise Dio's CLUBNUM would be 1 instead of 0.
cards.zh:
COUNTCLUB 只从 SC 计算，Dio 没有参加学会，SID 不在 SC，所以根本不在 view 里。问“参加不多于两个学会”时 Dio 会被漏掉。
解决：以 STUDENT 为左表 LEFT JOIN SC（或 SC RIGHT JOIN STUDENT），令每个学生都出现，并用 COUNT(CID)（不是 COUNT(*)），否则 Dio 的 CLUBNUM 会是 1 而不是 0。

ex.q: With COUNTCLUB built only from SC, which students are returned by SELECT SID FROM COUNTCLUB WHERE CLUBNUM = 0? Why?
ex.a: None. A student with no clubs has no rows in SC, so they never appear in the view; no row can have CLUBNUM = 0. The view must be built from STUDENT LEFT JOIN SC with COUNT(CID).
ex.az: 没有。没有学会的学生不在 SC，所以不在 view 中。

cards.t: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW and views built on views
cards.tz: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW 与用 view 建立 view
cards.en:
To modify an existing view, use CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW COUNTCLUB AS
  SELECT s.SID, COUNT(CID) AS CLUBNUM FROM SC
  RIGHT JOIN STUDENT s ON SC.SID = s.SID GROUP BY s.SID
Now Dio appears with CLUBNUM 0. (SQLite has no CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW: use DROP VIEW then CREATE VIEW.)

A view may refer to another view:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW SCORESHEET AS
  SELECT s.SID, NAME, SEX, s.CLASS, TEACH, LANG,
         SCORE1*0.4+SCORE2*0.6 AS FSCORE, CLUBNUM
  FROM STUDENT s, CLASS cl, COUNTCLUB cc
  WHERE s.CLASS = cl.CLASS AND s.SID = cc.SID
Tasks become very short:
  • SELECT NAME FROM SCORESHEET WHERE FSCORE > 60 AND CLUBNUM >= 2
  • SELECT NAME FROM SCORESHEET WHERE CLUBNUM = (SELECT MAX(CLUBNUM) FROM SCORESHEET) → Hans, Clem
cards.zh:
修改现有 view 用 CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW；改为 RIGHT JOIN STUDENT 并用 COUNT(CID) 后，Dio 以 CLUBNUM 0 出现。（SQLite 没有 CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW，要先 DROP VIEW 再 CREATE VIEW。）

View 可以引用另一个 view：SCORESHEET 加入 COUNTCLUB 的 CLUBNUM 后，任务变得很短，例如 WHERE FSCORE > 60 AND CLUBNUM >= 2；参加最多学会：CLUBNUM = (SELECT MAX(CLUBNUM) FROM SCORESHEET) → Hans、Clem。

ex.q: Modify view FORDER2 (Checkpoint 3.5(c)) so that it shows only unpaid orders and removes MID and MNAME.
ex.a:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW FORDER2 AS
  SELECT CID, OPRICE*(1-DISCOUNT)*NUM AS TPRICE, ETA
  FROM FORDER f, MEAL m
  WHERE f.MID = m.MID AND PAID = FALSE
ex.az: 用 CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW 重新定义，加 PAID = FALSE 条件。

cards.en:
If a view is no longer needed, delete it with DROP VIEW:
DROP VIEW COUNTCLUB
However, if a deleted view A is referenced in another view B, view B will no longer work after the deletion. SCORESHEET references COUNTCLUB, so after dropping COUNTCLUB, SCORESHEET fails.
The same goes for deleting a table which is referenced by a view: dropping STUDENT, SC or CLASS breaks the views built on them.

Dropping a view never deletes data in the base tables, because the view holds no data of its own.
cards.zh:
不再需要 view 时用 DROP VIEW 删除。
若被删除的 view A 被另一个 view B 引用，view B 之后便不能运作。SCORESHEET 引用 COUNTCLUB，删除 COUNTCLUB 后 SCORESHEET 就失效。删除被 view 引用的表也一样。

删除 view 不会删除表中的数据，因为 view 本身没有数据。

ex.q: View CPAYMENT is built on view FORDER2. What happens to CPAYMENT if FORDER2 is dropped? What happens to the data in FORDER?
ex.a: CPAYMENT no longer works (querying it gives an error) because it references FORDER2. The data in the table FORDER is not affected, since dropping a view does not delete any stored data.
ex.az: CPAYMENT 失效；FORDER 表的数据不受影响。

cards.en:
In summary, a view has the following properties (memorise):
  • It is used to show frequently retrieved data;
  • When used properly, it may simplify SQL statements;
  • It refers to data from other tables or views, thus does not need manual updates;
  • Similar to tables, its structure can be modified (CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW); and
  • If the referred tables or views are deleted, the view no longer works.
Extra exam points: a view can also hide fields users should not see (show only selected columns), and it saves storage compared with copying data into a new table, while always staying consistent with the base tables.
cards.zh:
View 的特性（要背）：
