If a field of a record stores no data, it is considered NULL, and NULL has no data type. NULL is not the same as 0: 0 is an integer or real number.

Piggy-bank analogy:
  • 124: there are 124 dollars in the piggy bank.
  • 0: there is no dollar in the piggy bank (but the bank exists).
  • NULL: there is no piggy bank (the value is unknown / not there).
Consequences: a candidate key or primary key cannot be NULL. Comparisons with NULL need IS NULL, not = NULL. Aggregates like AVG ignore NULL but count 0.
cards.zh:
如果某记录的字段没有数据，就当作 NULL，NULL 没有数据类型。NULL 不等于 0：0 是整数或实数。

扑满比喻：
  • 124：扑满里有 124 元。
  • 0：扑满里一元都没有（但扑满存在）。
  • NULL：根本没有扑满（值未知/不存在）。
影响：candidate key / primary key 不能是 NULL。判断 NULL 要用 IS NULL，不能用 = NULL。AVG 等聚合函数会忽略 NULL，但会计入 0。

ex.q: SCORE values are 80, 0, NULL. What do AVG(SCORE) and COUNT(SCORE) return?
ex.a:
NULL is ignored, 0 is counted.
AVG(SCORE) = (80 + 0) / 2 = 40; COUNT(SCORE) = 2; COUNT(*) = 3.
ex.az: NULL 被忽略，0 会计入：AVG = 40，COUNT(SCORE) = 2。

cards.en:
Sometimes a candidate key consists of more than one field. This type of candidate key is called a composite key.

In STUDENT, CLASS+CNO is a composite key: two students cannot share the same class and the same class number at the same time.

A composite key must be minimal: the removal of any field within the key results in duplicated values. CLASS alone repeats (many students in 3B) and CNO alone repeats (Clem and Gabe both have 15), so both fields are needed ("We are inseparable!").

SID+EMAIL is NOT a composite key: removing EMAIL does not create duplicates, because SID alone is already a candidate key. Adding EMAIL is meaningless.
cards.zh:
有时 candidate key 由多于一个字段组成，这种 candidate key 叫 composite key（复合键）。

STUDENT 中 CLASS+CNO 是复合键：两个学生不可能同时同班又同学号。

复合键必须 minimal：移除键中任何一个字段都会出现重复值。单靠 CLASS 会重复（3B 有很多人），单靠 CNO 也会重复（Clem 和 Gabe 都是 15），所以两个都要（"We are inseparable!"）。

SID+EMAIL 不是复合键：去掉 EMAIL 也不会重复，因为 SID 本身已是 candidate key，加上 EMAIL 毫无意义。

ex.q: Show with SQL that CLASS alone and CNO alone have duplicates but CLASS+CNO does not, in the sample STUDENT table.
ex.a:
SELECT CLASS, COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT GROUP BY CLASS HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT CNO, COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT GROUP BY CNO HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT CLASS, CNO, COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT
GROUP BY CLASS, CNO HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
The first two return rows (e.g. 3B, and CNO 15); the last returns nothing.
ex.az: 前两条有结果（3B、15），第三条没有结果，说明需要两个字段一起。

cards.tz: 判断候选键的常见陷阱
cards.en:
Activity 4.4 traps:
  • Not unique in reality: author + year of publication (an author can publish more than one book a year); home phone number for members (family members share it); software name; lesson starting time + ending time (many lessons run at the same time).
  • Not minimal: product identity code + product name (the name is unnecessary); computer model number + price (model number alone is enough).
Good candidate keys: Hong Kong identity card number for students; water bill account number for payment accounts; ISBN for books.

Method: (1) Could two real records ever share this value? If yes, not a key. (2) If several fields, remove each in turn: if the rest is still unique, it is not minimal.
cards.zh:
Activity 4.4 的陷阱：
  • 现实中不唯一：作者 + 出版年份（一年可出多本书）；会员的住宅电话（同住家人共用）；软件名称；课堂开始 + 结束时间（同一时间有很多课）。
  • 不 minimal：产品编号 + 产品名称（名称多余）；型号 + 价格（型号已足够）。
好的候选键：学生的香港身份证号码；水费账户的账户号码；书的 ISBN。

方法：(1) 现实中两条记录会不会有同一个值？会就不是 key。(2) 多字段的话，逐个拿走：剩下的仍唯一就不是 minimal。

ex.q: Which is a valid candidate key? A. Book: author + year of publication  B. Member: home phone number  C. Product: product code + product name  D. Student: HKID card number
ex.a:
D. No two students share an HKID number.
A: an author can publish several books in a year (not unique).
B: family members share a home phone (not unique).
C: product code alone is unique, so adding the name is not minimal.
ex.az: 答 D。A、B 不唯一；C 不 minimal。

cards.en:
The primary key of a table must be one of the candidate keys. It is a candidate key chosen by the database administrator to identify records. In other words, candidate keys are the candidates for the primary key.

A table can have multiple candidate keys, but only one primary key.

STUDENT has three candidate keys: SID, EMAIL and CLASS+CNO. Which to choose?
  • EMAIL is not the best: a student may change their personal email address (forgot password, account deactivated).
  • CLASS+CNO is not good: it usually changes every year.
  • SID is best: it does not change.
Choose a key that is stable (rarely changes), short and always present. In SQL: SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY or ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD PRIMARY KEY (SID).
cards.zh:
表的 primary key（主键）必须是其中一个 candidate key，是数据库管理员选来识别记录的 candidate key。换句话说，candidate keys 就是主键的候选人。

一张表可以有多个 candidate keys，但只能有一个 primary key。

STUDENT 有三个 candidate keys：SID、EMAIL、CLASS+CNO。选哪个？
  • EMAIL 不理想：学生可能更换个人电邮（忘记密码、账户停用）。
  • CLASS+CNO 不好：通常每年都改变。
  • SID 最好：不会改变。
选稳定（很少改变）、简短、一定有值的 key。SQL：SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY 或 ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD PRIMARY KEY (SID)。

ex.q: Checkpoint 4.3(c): SHOP(SNAME, ADDRESS, OPEN, CLOSE, OID) has no primary key. Suggest one and explain.
ex.a: ADDRESS: no two shops share the same full address. (SNAME is weaker since chain shops may share a name.)
ex.az: 选 ADDRESS：两间店不会有同一完整地址。

cards.en:
Foreign keys are used to show the relationship between records in two tables. A foreign key in a table X is always the primary key of another table Y. Table X is called the host table and table Y the parent table.

Example: STUDENT(SID, SNAME, SEX, CLASS, CID) and CLUB(CID, NAME, ROOM, TEACH). CID in STUDENT is a foreign key that links the host table STUDENT to the parent table CLUB.

Summary points: a foreign key shows the relationship between records in two tables; it is the primary key of the parent table; a table can have more than one foreign key (e.g. GAME has PID and GID; PAYMENT has PAYERID and PAYEEID). A foreign key value may be NULL (e.g. Ben has not joined a club).

SQL: ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD FOREIGN KEY (CID) REFERENCES CLUB(CID)
cards.zh:
Foreign key（外键）用来表示两张表中记录之间的关系。表 X 的外键一定是另一张表 Y 的主键。X 叫 host table，Y 叫 parent table。

例：STUDENT(SID, SNAME, SEX, CLASS, CID) 与 CLUB(CID, NAME, ROOM, TEACH)。STUDENT 的 CID 是外键，把 host table STUDENT 连到 parent table CLUB。

总结：外键表示两表记录的关系；它是 parent table 的主键；一张表可以有多于一个外键（如 GAME 有 PID、GID；PAYMENT 有 PAYERID、PAYEEID）。外键的值可以是 NULL（如 Ben 没参加学会）。

SQL：ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD FOREIGN KEY (CID) REFERENCES CLUB(CID)

ex.q: Football contest: PLAYER(PNAME, TID, TNAME, SNO, POS), TEAM(TID, TNAME, GID, PTS), GROUP(GID, GNAME). State the primary and foreign keys.
ex.a:
PLAYER: PK TID + SNO (squad number unique within a team); FK TID.
TEAM: PK TID; FK GID.
GROUP: PK GID; FK N/A.
ex.az: PLAYER 主键 TID+SNO、外键 TID；TEAM 主键 TID、外键 GID；GROUP 主键 GID、无外键。

cards.t: Benefits of using a foreign key
cards.en:
Using a foreign key (storing only the identity code of the related record) allows us to manage data better:
  • When the name, room or teacher of a club is updated in CLUB, we do not have to update STUDENT, because STUDENT stores only the club's identity code.
  • Even if the records of all students who join a certain club are deleted in STUDENT, the data of this club is kept in CLUB.
Compare the single table STUDENTCLUB: changing Science Club's teacher needs three records updated, otherwise the data is inconsistent; if Ada (only Art Club member) leaves, Art Club data is lost.

Further exam point (football Q): storing an integer code (POS 0 to 3) instead of a string ("Midfielder") uses less storage and makes renaming a position a one-row update; it also stops misspelled values.
cards.zh:
使用外键（只存相关记录的 identity code）让数据更易管理：
  • 学会的名字、房间或老师在 CLUB 中更新时，不用改 STUDENT，因为 STUDENT 只存学会编号。
  • 即使某学会所有学生记录都被删，该学会的数据仍保留在 CLUB。
对比单表 STUDENTCLUB：改 Science Club 老师要改 3 条，否则数据不一致；Art Club 唯一成员 Ada 离开，Art Club 资料就丢失。

延伸考点（足球题）：用整数代码（POS 0–3）代替字符串（"Midfielder"）节省储存空间，改位置名称只需改一行，也避免拼错。

ex.q: PLAYER has over 30000 records. Give two advantages of storing POS as an integer foreign key to POSITION(POS, POSTYPE) instead of a string.
ex.a:
1. An integer takes less storage than repeating strings like 'Midfielder' 30000 times.
2. If a position name changes, only one record in POSITION is updated, not thousands in PLAYER; also prevents inconsistent spellings / invalid values (with referential integrity).
ex.az: 1. 节省空间；2. 改名只改 POSITION 一行，避免不一致。

cards.t: Example 4.2: splitting tables and writing schemas
cards.en:
Example 4.2: GAME(ID, NAME, PNAME, GID, WEBSITE, PHONE, PRICE), GENRE(ID, NAME, RES).

(a) GAME (ID, NAME, PNAME, GID, WEBSITE, PHONE, PRICE), Foreign key: GID. GENRE (ID, NAME, RES), Foreign key: N/A.
(b) WEBSITE characters; PHONE characters (3320-2310 has '-'); PRICE real / float (30.9).
(c) Publisher data (PNAME, WEBSITE, PHONE) moves to a new table with its own code:
GAME (ID, NAME, PID, GID, PRICE), Foreign key: PID, GID
PUBLISHER (ID, NAME, WEBSITE, PHONE), Foreign key: N/A

Method for (c): find every field that describes the other entity, move them out, keep only the new identity code as a foreign key.
cards.zh:
Example 4.2：GAME(ID, NAME, PNAME, GID, WEBSITE, PHONE, PRICE)、GENRE(ID, NAME, RES)。

(a) GAME (ID, NAME, PNAME, GID, WEBSITE, PHONE, PRICE)，外键 GID；GENRE (ID, NAME, RES)，外键 N/A。
(b) WEBSITE 字符；PHONE 字符（3320-2310 有 '-'）；PRICE real / float（30.9）。
(c) 出版商资料（PNAME、WEBSITE、PHONE）移到新表，并给每个出版商编号：
GAME (ID, NAME, PID, GID, PRICE)，外键 PID、GID
PUBLISHER (ID, NAME, WEBSITE, PHONE)，外键 N/A

(c) 的方法：找出所有描述另一个 entity 的字段，搬出去，只保留新的编号作外键。

ex.q: Checkpoint 4.2(c): BOOK(ISBN, BNAME, ANAME, ANAT, AAGE, PDATE, PAGE, PRICE, PID). Author data moves to AUTHOR with code AID. Write both schemas.
ex.a:
BOOK (ISBN, BNAME, AID, PDATE, PAGE, PRICE, PID), Foreign key: AID, PID
AUTHOR (AID, ANAME, ANAT, AAGE), Foreign key: N/A
ex.az: 作者相关字段 ANAME、ANAT、AAGE 搬到 AUTHOR，BOOK 只留 AID 作外键。

cards.t: Add a field instead of overwriting a value (DISCOUNT)
cards.tz: 新增字段代替直接改值（DISCOUNT）
cards.en:
Example 4.2(d): a publisher gives a two-week discount on its games; different games have different discounts. Instead of changing PRICE, the administrator adds a field DISCOUNT and calculates the final price from PRICE and DISCOUNT.

Advantage: the original price is not lost. After two weeks, simply set DISCOUNT of those games back to 0 to restore the original prices. If PRICE were overwritten, the original price would be permanently lost from the database.

Same idea in Checkpoint 4.2(d): store birthdays instead of ages; and in Chapter Exercise Q1(e): if a menu is prone to change, store items in a separate MENU table with codes so a change is one update, not a mass update.
cards.zh:
Example 4.2(d)：出版商给旗下游戏两星期折扣，每款折扣不同。管理员不直接改 PRICE，而是新增字段 DISCOUNT，用 PRICE 和 DISCOUNT 计算最终价格。

好处：原价不会丢失。两星期后只要把那些游戏的 DISCOUNT 设回 0 就恢复原价。若直接覆盖 PRICE，原价就永久丢失。

同类思路：Checkpoint 4.2(d) 存生日而非年龄；Chapter Exercise Q1(e)：若菜单常改，把菜式放进独立的 MENU 表用编号引用，改菜单只需改一处，不用大量更新。

ex.q: GAME(ID, NAME, PRICE, DISCOUNT) where DISCOUNT is a fraction such as 0.2. Write a query showing each game's final price, and the SQL to end the promotion for publisher 7's games (PID = 7).
ex.a:
SELECT NAME, PRICE * (1 - DISCOUNT) AS FINAL FROM GAME;
UPDATE GAME SET DISCOUNT = 0 WHERE PID = 7;
ex.az: 用 PRICE*(1-DISCOUNT) 计算最终价；结束优惠就把 DISCOUNT 设 0。

cards.en:
When a field is expected to be searched frequently, we can index that field to speed up the data retrieval process (see also Chapter 3, section 3.4).

Indexing a field creates an index table containing the indexed field and a pointer to the related records only. E.g. indexing NAME of STUDENT gives an index table (NAME, SID) sorted by NAME: Ada → 03493, Ben → 03517, ...

Since the data in the indexed field of the index table is sorted, it allows the DBMS to perform binary search instead of checking every record one by one. Even if Guy is the last student in the database table, the DBMS finds him in four searches among 11 names.

SQL: CREATE INDEX IDX_NAME ON STUDENT (NAME)
cards.zh:
当某字段预计会经常被搜寻，可以为它建立 index（索引），加快数据检索（亦见第 3 章 3.4 节）。

为字段建索引会产生一个只含该字段和指向相关记录的 pointer 的 index table。例如为 STUDENT 的 NAME 建索引，得到按 NAME 排序的 (NAME, SID)：Ada → 03493、Ben → 03517……

因为 index table 中被索引的字段已排序，DBMS 可以用 binary search（二分搜寻），不用逐条检查。即使 Guy 是原表最后一个学生，在 11 个名字中 DBMS 也只需 4 次就找到他。

SQL：CREATE INDEX IDX_NAME ON STUDENT (NAME)

ex.q: Chapter Exercise Q3(e): a website lets users search films by name, actors by name, and view films by release year. Which fields should be indexed?
ex.az: 根据网站的搜寻功能，为 FNAME、ANAME、FYEAR 建索引。

cards.en:
An index is not free:
  • The DBMS needs to update the index table whenever changes are made to the data in the indexed field or a new record is added (and when records are deleted). This takes time, so inserts and updates become slower.
  • The index table takes storage space.
Therefore it is wise to index a field only if necessary: only frequently searched fields should be indexed.

Exam answer to "Why should we not index all fields in a table?" (2 marks): Each index takes extra storage space [1]; every insert/update of indexed fields requires the index tables to be updated, which takes time and slows down data modification [1].
cards.zh:
索引有代价：
  • 每当被索引字段的数据改变或新增记录（以及删除记录）时，DBMS 要更新 index table，这需要时间，令新增和更新变慢。
  • Index table 本身占储存空间。
所以只在有需要时才建索引：只为经常被搜寻的字段建索引。

"Why should we not index all fields in a table?"（2 分）标准答案：Each index takes extra storage space [1]；every insert/update of indexed fields requires the index tables to be updated, which takes time [1]。

ex.q: A LOG table receives 500 new rows per second and is searched only once a month. Should its fields be indexed?
ex.a: Probably not (or only the one field used in the monthly search). Every insert would also update each index, slowing the frequent inserts and using storage, while the benefit (faster search) is rarely used.
ex.az: 插入非常频繁、搜寻很少，索引得不偿失。

cards.t: Counting binary searches in an index
cards.en:
Binary search on a sorted index: compare with the middle item; if not found, keep only the half that could contain the target and repeat.

With positions low..high, middle = (low + high) div 2. For 11 names (Ada..Jean), 1st search position 6 (Finn), then 9 (Hans), then 7 (Gabe), then 8 (Guy): Guy needs 4 searches.

Worst case for n records = the smallest k with 2k > n, i.e. ⌈log2(n+1)⌉. 15 records → 4 searches; 1000 records → log21000 ≈ 9.97, so 10 searches. Compare linear search: up to 1000 comparisons.

In Activity 4.5 (15 books), the 8th book (Les Misérables) needs 1 search; positions 4 and 12 need 2; positions 2, 6, 10, 14 need 3; odd positions need 4.
cards.zh:
二分搜寻：与中间项比较；找不到就只保留可能包含目标的一半，重复。

位置 low..high，中间 = (low + high) div 2。11 个名字（Ada..Jean）：第 1 次位置 6（Finn），然后 9（Hans）、7（Gabe）、8（Guy）：Guy 要 4 次。

n 条记录的最坏情况是使 2k > n 的最小 k，即 ⌈log2(n+1)⌉。15 条 → 4 次；1000 条 → log21000 ≈ 9.97，所以 10 次。线性搜寻最多要 1000 次。

Activity 4.5（15 本书）：第 8 本（Les Misérables）1 次；第 4、12 本 2 次；第 2、6、10、14 本 3 次；奇数位置 4 次。

ex.q: Write a Python function that returns how many comparisons binary search needs to find position p (1-based) among n sorted items. Check Three Little Pigs (position 14 of 15).
ex.a:
def searches(n, p):
    low, high, k = 1, n, 0
    while low <= high:
        k += 1
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        if mid == p: return k
        if p < mid: high = mid - 1
        else: low = mid + 1

print(searches(15, 14))  # 3
Order: 8 → 12 → 14, so 3 searches.
ex.az: 模拟二分搜寻：8 → 12 → 14，共 3 次。

cards.en:
When we update the data in a DBMS, the integrity of data may be affected, meaning that the data is no longer accurate or valid. Integrity means the data is accurate, valid and consistent.

Three aspects of integrity:
IntegrityConcern
Entity integrityThe existence and validity of the primary key
Referential integrityThe validity of the foreign key
Domain integrityThe data types and constraints of the attributes
Once keys, data types and constraints are defined, the DBMS checks every INSERT and UPDATE (and for foreign keys, DELETE) and rejects any statement that would break them.
cards.zh:
在 DBMS 中更新数据时，数据的完整性（integrity）可能受影响，即数据不再准确或有效。Integrity 就是数据准确、有效、一致。

三方面：
Integrity关注点
Entity integrityPrimary key 是否存在及有效
Referential integrityForeign key 是否有效
Domain integrityAttributes 的 data types and constraints
定义好 key、数据类型和 constraint 后，DBMS 会检查每个 INSERT、UPDATE（外键还检查 DELETE），拒绝任何会破坏完整性的语句。

ex.q: For each problem, name the integrity violated: (i) two records with SID 03493; (ii) STUDENT.CID = 5 but CLUB has only 1 to 4; (iii) CNO = -6.
ex.a:
(i) Entity integrity (duplicate primary key).
(ii) Referential integrity (foreign key references a non-existent value).
(iii) Domain integrity (value outside {1 .. 30}).
ex.az: (i) 实体完整性；(ii) 参照完整性；(iii) 域完整性。

cards.en:
Entity integrity means that:
  • a table must have its primary key defined; and
  • the primary key for each record is unique and not NULL.
Once the primary key is defined, the DBMS ensures each primary key is unique and not NULL. With ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD PRIMARY KEY (SID), you will NOT be able to:
  • insert a new record with SID 03493, or update a record to have SID 03493, since Ada already has it; or
  • insert a new record without SID (NULL).
A table violates entity integrity if: it does not have a primary key; its primary key contains duplicated values; or its primary key contains a NULL value.

Note for SQLite: a non-INTEGER PRIMARY KEY may accept NULL unless declared NOT NULL; MySQL always forbids NULL in a primary key.
cards.zh:
Entity integrity（实体完整性）指：
  • 表必须定义 primary key；且
  • 每条记录的 primary key 唯一且不是 NULL。
定义主键后，DBMS 会保证主键唯一且非 NULL。执行 ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD PRIMARY KEY (SID) 后，不能：
  • 插入 SID 为 03493 的新记录，或把某记录的 SID 改成 03493（Ada 已用）；
  • 插入没有 SID（NULL）的新记录。
违反 entity integrity 的情况：没有主键；主键有重复值；主键有 NULL。

SQLite 注意：非 INTEGER 的 PRIMARY KEY 若没写 NOT NULL 可能接受 NULL；MySQL 一定禁止。

ex.q: Run in SQLite: CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, NAME VARCHAR(40)); INSERT ('03493','Ada'); then INSERT ('03493','Zoe'). What happens?
ex.a:
The second INSERT fails:
UNIQUE constraint failed: STUDENT.SID
The DBMS keeps entity integrity by rejecting a duplicate primary key. INSERT INTO STUDENT (NAME) VALUES ('Kay') also fails (NOT NULL constraint failed).
ex.az: 重复主键被拒绝（UNIQUE constraint failed），缺 SID 的插入也被拒绝。

cards.en:
Referential integrity means that the references of foreign keys in a table are valid, so that its relationship with other tables remains intact.

Define a foreign key and state which table's primary key it references:
ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD FOREIGN KEY (CID) REFERENCES CLUB(CID)
(host table STUDENT, foreign key CID, parent table CLUB, primary key CLUB.CID).

Then the DBMS ensures that excluding NULL values, each foreign key value in the host table must come from the primary key values in the parent table. It does not stop a record from having NULL as its foreign key (Ben has no club).

A table violates referential integrity if its foreign key contains a value that cannot be found in the field it references ("I joined the 5th club." "There is no 5th club.").

SQLite note: run PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; to enforce foreign keys; MySQL (InnoDB) enforces them by default.
cards.zh:
Referential integrity（参照完整性）指表中外键的引用都有效，与其他表的关系保持完整。

定义外键并指出它引用哪张表的主键：
ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD FOREIGN KEY (CID) REFERENCES CLUB(CID)
（host table STUDENT、外键 CID、parent table CLUB、主键 CLUB.CID）。

之后 DBMS 保证：除 NULL 外，host table 中每个外键值都必须来自 parent table 的主键值。它不会禁止外键为 NULL（Ben 没学会）。

违反参照完整性：外键含有在被引用字段中找不到的值（"我参加了第 5 个学会。""根本没有第 5 个学会。"）。

SQLite 注意：要执行 PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; 才会检查外键；MySQL（InnoDB）默认检查。

ex.q: Write an SQL query that finds students whose CID breaks referential integrity (CID not NULL and not in CLUB).
ex.a:
SELECT SID, CID FROM STUDENT
WHERE CID IS NOT NULL
  AND CID NOT IN (SELECT CID FROM CLUB)
ex.az: 找出 CID 不为 NULL 而又不在 CLUB 中的学生。

cards.t: Four actions blocked by referential integrity
cards.tz: 参照完整性禁止的四种操作
cards.en:
The DBMS prevents actions that would make a foreign key value in the host table reference a primary key value that does not exist in the parent table. You will NOT be able to:
  1. insert a new record into STUDENT (host) with a CID that does not exist in CLUB (Fig 4.6, CID 5);
  2. update a record in STUDENT to have a CID that does not exist in CLUB (Fig 4.7);
  3. delete a record from CLUB (parent) with a CID that is referenced by STUDENT (Fig 4.8);
  4. update the CID of a record in CLUB that is referenced by STUDENT to a new value (Fig 4.9).
Memory aid: host table → insert / update the FK; parent table → delete / update the PK. Deleting an unreferenced club (e.g. English Club, CID 3) is allowed.

To remove a referenced parent record you must first delete or change the related child records (Checkpoint 4.3(d): remove the products sold at a removed shop).
cards.zh:
DBMS 会阻止令 host table 外键引用 parent table 中不存在主键值的操作。不能：
  1. 向 STUDENT（host）插入 CID 在 CLUB 不存在的记录（图 4.6，CID 5）；
  2. 把 STUDENT 记录的 CID 更新为 CLUB 中不存在的值（图 4.7）；
  3. 从 CLUB（parent）删除一个被 STUDENT 引用的 CID（图 4.8）；
  4. 把 CLUB 中被引用记录的 CID 改成新值（图 4.9）。
记法：host table → 插入/更新外键；parent table → 删除/更新主键。删除没被引用的学会（如 English Club, CID 3）是可以的。

要删除被引用的 parent 记录，必须先删除或修改相关 child 记录（Checkpoint 4.3(d)：店被删，该店卖的产品也要删）。

ex.q: With foreign keys on, which succeed? (i) DELETE FROM CLUB WHERE CID = 3 (ii) DELETE FROM CLUB WHERE CID = 2 (iii) UPDATE STUDENT SET CID = 3 WHERE SID = '03517'
ex.a:
(i) Succeeds: no student references CID 3.
(ii) Fails: Ada references CID 2.
(iii) Succeeds: CID 3 exists in CLUB.
ex.az: (i) 成功；(ii) 失败（Ada 引用 2）；(iii) 成功。

cards.en:
Domain integrity means that the value of an attribute must fall within a reasonable domain. In a DBMS we define the domain by setting the attribute's data type and constraints:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (
  SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY,
  NAME VARCHAR(40),
  SEX CHAR(1),
  CLASS CHAR(2),
  CNO INT,
  CHECK (LENGTH(SID) = 5),
  CHECK (SEX IN ('M', 'F')),
  CHECK (CLASS IN ('1A', '1B', '1C', '1D')),
  CHECK (CNO BETWEEN 1 AND 30)
)
Then you will NOT be able to: insert an SID of less than 5 characters; update CLASS to anything other than 1A to 1D; insert a CNO of 'One'; update CNO to -6.

A table violates domain integrity if its field contains a value that is not within its domain ("My class number is 3.14159..."). E.g. a shop CLOSE time of 20:90.
cards.zh:
Domain integrity（域完整性）指属性的值必须落在合理的 domain 内。DBMS 中用属性的 data type 和 constraints 定义 domain：
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (
  SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY,
  NAME VARCHAR(40),
  SEX CHAR(1),
  CLASS CHAR(2),
  CNO INT,
  CHECK (LENGTH(SID) = 5),
  CHECK (SEX IN ('M', 'F')),
  CHECK (CLASS IN ('1A', '1B', '1C', '1D')),
  CHECK (CNO BETWEEN 1 AND 30)
)
之后不能：插入少于 5 个字符的 SID；把 CLASS 改成 1A–1D 以外的值；插入 CNO 为 'One'；把 CNO 改成 -6。

字段含有不在 domain 内的值就违反 domain integrity（"我的学号是 3.14159……"），例如店铺关门时间 20:90。

ex.q: Using the table above, which statements are rejected? (i) INSERT VALUES ('0350','Kim','F','1A',3) (ii) INSERT VALUES ('03520','Kim','F','1E',3) (iii) UPDATE STUDENT SET CNO = 30 WHERE SID = '03493'
ex.a:
(i) Rejected: LENGTH(SID) = 4.
(ii) Rejected: CLASS '1E' not in the set.
(iii) Accepted: 30 is within 1 to 30 (BETWEEN is inclusive).
ex.az: (i)、(ii) 被拒；(iii) 可以，BETWEEN 包含两端。

cards.en:
Use Table 4.17 as a checklist:
  • Entity integrity: is there a primary key? Look for a field (or minimal combination) with no duplicates and no NULL. If every possible key has duplicates, or there is no primary key defined, entity integrity is violated.
  • Referential integrity: for each foreign key, is every non-NULL value present in the parent's primary key?
  • Domain integrity: is any value outside its stated range/set/type (e.g. SROW = 'S' when rows are 1 to 5; time 20:90)?
Activity 4.6 Q1: CLASS, CLASSNO, GENDER, SNAME. Every field has duplicates, and even CLASS+CLASSNO repeats (6A, 22 twice) → entity integrity only.
Activity 4.6 Q2: STUDENT(SCLN, SROW, ...) has SROW = 'S' (domain) and CID 3169 not in CLUB (referential); SCLN+SROW can be the primary key → (2) and (3) only.
cards.zh:
用表 4.17 当检查清单：
  • Entity integrity：有没有主键？找一个没有重复、没有 NULL 的字段（或最少字段组合）。如所有可能的 key 都有重复，或没定义主键，就违反。
  • Referential integrity：每个外键的非 NULL 值都在 parent 的主键里吗？
  • Domain integrity：有没有值超出范围/集合/类型（如行号 1–5 却出现 'S'；时间 20:90）？
Activity 4.6 Q1：CLASS、CLASSNO、GENDER、SNAME，每个字段都有重复，连 CLASS+CLASSNO 也重复（6A, 22 两次）→ 只违反 entity integrity。
Activity 4.6 Q2：SROW = 'S'（domain），CID 3169 不在 CLUB（referential）；SCLN+SROW 可作主键 → (2) and (3) only。

ex.q: Checkpoint 4.3(a): SHOP has CLOSE = 20:90 for one shop. Which integrity is violated?
ex.a: Domain integrity: 20:90 is not a valid time, so it lies outside the domain {00:00 .. 23:59} of CLOSE.
ex.az: 20:90 不是有效时间 → 域完整性。

cards.t: Maintaining referential integrity when a parent record is removed
cards.tz: 删除 parent 记录时保持参照完整性
cards.en:
If a parent record is removed, child records that reference it would point to nothing. To maintain referential integrity, before (or together with) removing the parent record you must:
  • delete the related child records, e.g. Checkpoint 4.3(d): if a shop is removed from SHOP, the records of all products sold at that shop are removed as well; or
  • update their foreign key to another valid value or to NULL (if allowed), e.g. Exercise Q2(c): when a team withdraws, delete or update the players of that team in PLAYER.
MySQL and SQLite can automate this with FOREIGN KEY (SID) REFERENCES SHOP(SID) ON DELETE CASCADE (or ON DELETE SET NULL). Warning (Exercise Q3(f)): cascaded deletes lose data permanently; to bring a removed film and its STARRING records back, roll back / restore from a backup.
cards.zh:
删除 parent 记录后，引用它的 child 记录就会指向不存在的东西。为保持参照完整性，删除 parent 前（或同时）必须：
  • 删除相关 child 记录，例如 Checkpoint 4.3(d)：SHOP 删除一间店，该店所卖产品的记录也要一并删除；或
  • 把它们的外键改成另一个有效值或 NULL（如允许），例如 Exercise Q2(c)：球队退出比赛，要删除或修改 PLAYER 中该队球员。
MySQL 和 SQLite 可用 FOREIGN KEY (SID) REFERENCES SHOP(SID) ON DELETE CASCADE（或 ON DELETE SET NULL）自动处理。注意（Exercise Q3(f)）：连带删除会永久丢失数据；要把删掉的电影和它的 STARRING 记录找回，要用备份 rollback / 还原。

ex.q: SHOP 'S2' is closing. Write the two SQL statements, in the correct order, to remove it while keeping referential integrity (PRODUCT.SID references SHOP).
ex.a:
Delete the children first, then the parent:
DELETE FROM PRODUCT WHERE SID = 'S2';
DELETE FROM SHOP WHERE SID = 'S2';
Reversing the order would be rejected (the shop is still referenced).
ex.az: 先删 PRODUCT 里的子记录，再删 SHOP。次序反了会被拒绝。

cards.en:
A rollback means restoring a database to its previous state.

When managing a database, errors may occur and corrupt the integrity of data (wrong SQL, wrong order of statements, a program aborted halfway, hardware failure). Therefore we must make a backup of our database regularly. When needed, we can roll back the database using the backup.

Key points to memorise:
  • Purpose: undo harmful changes and restore data integrity.
  • Method: regular backups, then restore the backup (e.g. with mysqldump / mysql in MySQL).
  • Changes made after the backup are lost by the restore, so back up often.
In SQL, a transaction can also be undone before it is committed: BEGIN; ... ROLLBACK;
cards.zh:
Rollback（回滚）就是把数据库还原到先前的状态。

管理数据库时，错误可能发生并破坏数据完整性（SQL 写错、语句次序错、程序中途中断、硬件故障）。所以必须定期备份数据库，需要时用备份把数据库 roll back。

要背：
  • 目的：撤销有害的改动，恢复数据完整性。
  • 方法：定期备份，再还原备份（MySQL 可用 mysqldump / mysql）。
  • 备份之后的改动在还原时会丢失，所以要经常备份。
SQL 中，尚未 commit 的 transaction 也可撤销：BEGIN; ... ROLLBACK;

ex.q: In SQLite run: BEGIN; DELETE FROM STUDENT; ROLLBACK; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT; (table had 10 rows). What is printed?
ex.a: 10. ROLLBACK undoes every change since BEGIN, so the deleted rows return.
ex.az: ROLLBACK 撤销 BEGIN 之后的所有改动，所以仍是 10 行。

cards.t: Example: SQL statements run in the wrong order
cards.en:
New school year: the teacher wants to (1) delete students in 6A and (2) promote all 5A students to 6A. Correct order:
DELETE FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS = '6A';
UPDATE STUDENT SET CLASS = '6A' WHERE CLASS = '5A';
But they mess up the order: the UPDATE runs first, so all 5A students become 6A; then the DELETE removes every 6A student, leaving the table empty (Hans, Ivy, Jean and all former 5A students are gone).

This is where we need a rollback: restore the database from the backup made days ago, then run the two statements in the correct order.

Lesson: the order of SQL statements matters; test on a copy or inside a transaction, and keep regular backups.
cards.zh:
新学年：老师要 (1) 删除 6A 学生，(2) 把所有 5A 学生升到 6A。正确次序：
DELETE FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS = '6A';
UPDATE STUDENT SET CLASS = '6A' WHERE CLASS = '5A';
但次序弄反了：先 UPDATE，5A 全变成 6A；再 DELETE 把所有 6A 学生删掉，表变空（Hans、Ivy、Jean 和原 5A 学生全部消失）。

这时就需要 rollback：用几天前的备份还原，再按正确次序执行两条语句。

教训：SQL 语句次序很重要；先在副本或 transaction 里测试，并定期备份。

ex.q: STUDENT has 3 students in 6A and 7 in 5A. How many rows remain after (a) the correct order, (b) the wrong order?
ex.a:
(a) DELETE removes 3, UPDATE changes 7 → 7 rows (all in 6A).
(b) UPDATE makes 10 rows 6A, DELETE removes all 10 → 0 rows.
ex.az: (a) 剩 7 行；(b) 剩 0 行。

cards.t: Lab 4.1: backup with mysqldump and restore with mysql
cards.en:
Backup (in Command Prompt):
mysqldump -u root -p SCHOOL > school.sql
  • mysqldump: export the data of the database into a SQL file;
  • root: username; -p: ask for the password;
  • SCHOOL: the database to export; school.sql: the output file.
The file contains SQL statements such as CREATE TABLE and INSERT INTO that recreate every table in SCHOOL with exactly the current data.

Restore (rollback):
mysql -u root -p -h localhost SCHOOL < school.sql
  • mysql: run a SQL file; localhost: host name; SCHOOL: database to import into.
Then type the password and check the data. If 'mysqldump' is not recognised, add the MySQL bin folder (e.g. C:\Program Files\MySQL\MySQL Server 8.0\bin) to the PATH environment variable.

SQLite equivalent: sqlite3 school.db .dump > school.sql and sqlite3 new.db < school.sql.
cards.zh:
备份（命令提示字元）：
mysqldump -u root -p SCHOOL > school.sql
  • mysqldump：把数据库数据导出成 SQL 文件；
  • root：用户名；-p：要求输入密码；
  • SCHOOL：要导出的数据库；school.sql：输出文件名。
文件里是 CREATE TABLE、INSERT INTO 等语句，可以按现在的数据完整重建 SCHOOL 中所有表。

还原（rollback）：
mysql -u root -p -h localhost SCHOOL < school.sql
  • mysql：执行 SQL 文件；localhost：主机名；SCHOOL：导入到哪个数据库。
输入密码后检查数据。如提示 'mysqldump' is not recognised，把 MySQL 的 bin 文件夹加进 PATH 环境变量。

SQLite 对应：sqlite3 school.db .dump > school.sql 和 sqlite3 new.db < school.sql。

ex.q: User admin wants to back up database SHOP to shop_bak.sql and later restore it on localhost. Write both commands.
ex.a:
mysqldump -u admin -p SHOP > shop_bak.sql
mysql -u admin -p -h localhost SHOP < shop_bak.sql
ex.az: 备份用 mysqldump 加 >，还原用 mysql 加 <。

cards.t: Rolling back an interrupted batch of updates
cards.tz: 中途中断的更新要回滚
cards.en:
Checkpoint 4.4: PAYMENT(TID, PAYERID, PAYEEID, AMOUNT, TTIME) and ACCOUNT(AID, UNAME, DEPOSIT). After a payment:
  • the deposit of the payer account is subtracted by the amount; and
  • the deposit of the payee account is added by the amount.
A program updating ACCOUNT for 10,000 payments was aborted by an error, and nobody knows where it stopped.

What to do: roll back the database to its previous state (the backup before the program ran), then run the program again. Reason: some payments may be halfway through, e.g. the payer's deposit was subtracted but the payee's was not added, so the totals are now wrong (data integrity is corrupted). Simply rerunning would apply some payments twice.

In SQL this is why both updates of one payment should be in one transaction.
cards.zh:
Checkpoint 4.4：PAYMENT(TID, PAYERID, PAYEEID, AMOUNT, TTIME)、ACCOUNT(AID, UNAME, DEPOSIT)。每笔付款后：
  • 付款人账户的存款减去金额；
  • 收款人账户的存款加上金额。
一个程序在处理 10,000 笔付款时因错误中断，不知停在哪里。

做法：把数据库 roll back 到之前的状态（程序执行前的备份），再重新执行程序。原因：某些付款可能只做了一半，例如付款人已扣钱、收款人未加钱，总额就错了（破坏数据完整性）。直接重跑又会令部分付款重复处理。

所以 SQL 中同一笔付款的两个更新应放在同一个 transaction 里。

ex.q: Write the SQL for payment TID 77: account 'A1' pays 'A2' $50, so that both updates happen together or not at all.
ex.a:
BEGIN;
UPDATE ACCOUNT SET DEPOSIT = DEPOSIT - 50 WHERE AID = 'A1';
UPDATE ACCOUNT SET DEPOSIT = DEPOSIT + 50 WHERE AID = 'A2';
COMMIT;
If an error occurs before COMMIT, run ROLLBACK and neither change is kept.
ex.az: 两条 UPDATE 放在同一个 transaction，出错就 ROLLBACK。

cards.t: Chapter Exercise: linking table STARRING and table design
cards.tz: 章末练习：连接表 STARRING 与表设计
cards.en:
Exercise Q3: ACTOR(AID, ANAME, SEX, AGE, FID), FILM(FID, FNAME, FYEAR).
  • (a) Relationship: actors star in films (films are starred by actors).
  • (b) SEX stored as Boolean → domain {TRUE, FALSE} (or {0, 1}).
  • (c) ACTOR: PK AID, FK FID; FILM: PK FID, FK N/A.
  • (d) Why create STARRING(FID, AID, CTYPE, ROLE)? With one FID field, an actor could only be linked to one film; an actor acts in many films and a film has many actors. STARRING stores one row per actor-film pair (PK FID+AID).
Exercise Q1 (MEALORDER with no unique field): it violates entity integrity (no primary key; two employees may share a name). Fix: add an order/employee ID as the primary key. Form controls that only allow numbers for r and s are validation (data control) that maintains domain integrity.
cards.zh:
Exercise Q3：ACTOR(AID, ANAME, SEX, AGE, FID)、FILM(FID, FNAME, FYEAR)。
  • (a) 关系：actors star in films。
  • (b) SEX 用 Boolean → domain {TRUE, FALSE}（或 {0, 1}）。
  • (c) ACTOR：主键 AID、外键 FID；FILM：主键 FID、外键 N/A。
  • (d) 为何建 STARRING(FID, AID, CTYPE, ROLE)？只有一个 FID 字段，每个演员只能连到一部电影；但演员会演多部电影，电影也有多个演员。STARRING 每对演员-电影存一行（主键 FID+AID）。
Exercise Q1（MEALORDER 没有唯一字段）：违反 entity integrity（没主键，员工可能同名）。修正：加入订单/员工编号作主键。表单只容许 r、s 输入数字是 validation（数据控制），维护 domain integrity。

ex.q: Write an SQL query listing every film name with the names of actors starring in it, using FILM, STARRING and ACTOR.
ex.a:
SELECT F.FNAME, A.ANAME
FROM FILM F, STARRING S, ACTOR A
WHERE F.FID = S.FID AND S.AID = A.AID
ex.az: 通过 STARRING 连接 FILM 和 ACTOR。

mc.q: How does a relational database organise data?
o: In a tree of parent and child nodes
In tables of rows and columns
As a list of key–value pairs only
mc.e: A relational database organises data in tabular form; each row is a record.
mc.ez: 关系式数据库用表格（行和列）组织数据。

mc.q: Which type of database was the first to be developed and is now almost replaced by the relational database?
mc.e: The hierarchical database came first and is now obsolete.
mc.ez: 层次式数据库最早出现，现已过时。

mc.q: In a DBMS, an entity type is usually represented by a
mc.e: Entity type → table.

mc.q: In a DBMS, an entity is usually represented by a
mc.e: Entity → record (row / tuple).

mc.q: In a DBMS, a relationship is usually represented by
mc.e: Relationships are implemented by foreign keys between tables.
mc.ez: Relationship 用 foreign key 表示。

mc.q: In a DBMS, the domain of an attribute is implemented by
mc.e: Domain → data type and constraint.
mc.ez: Domain 用数据类型和约束实现。

mc.q: Another name for a record in a table is a
mc.e: A record is sometimes referred to as a tuple.

mc.q: Which of the following is a conceptual object rather than a physical object?
mc.e: Transactions, organisations, courses and jobs are conceptual objects.

mc.q: Which set of entity type and attributes is NOT correct?
mc.e: Weight is an attribute of computers; computers should be the entity type.
mc.ez: Weight 是 computers 的属性。

mc.q: Which set of entity type and attributes is NOT correct?
mc.e: Age is an attribute of patients, not an entity type.
mc.ez: Age 是 patients 的属性。

mc.q: Which of the following is a derived attribute?
mc.e: BMI can be calculated from weight and height.
mc.ez: BMI 可由体重身高计算。

mc.q: A table stores OPEN, CLOSE and BHOUR (business hours) of shops. Which statement is correct?
o: BHOUR must be the primary key
mc.e: BHOUR is the time difference between OPEN and CLOSE.
mc.ez: BHOUR 由 OPEN 和 CLOSE 算出。

mc.q: Why is it usually better to store a person's birthday rather than age?
o: Age cannot be stored as an integer
Birthday does not change, so data need not be updated frequently; age can be calculated
mc.e: Age changes every year; birthday does not.
mc.ez: 年龄每年变，生日不变，年龄可以计算出来。

mc.q: A relationship in a relational database usually represents a
mc.e: Relationships are verbs, e.g. join, manage.

mc.q: Which set of entity types and relationship is correct?
o: Lesson, Teacher: X is taught by Y
Patient, Doctor: X is married to Y
mc.e: A lesson is taught by a teacher. Products are sold by shops; height is an attribute.

mc.q: Which set of entity types and relationship is correct?
o: Payment, Recipient: X is received by Y
Author, Book: X is written by Y
Duration, Concert: X is the time occupied by Y
mc.e: A payment is received by a recipient. Authors write books; duration is an attribute; employees are employed by companies.

mc.q: 'Students study Physics, Chemistry or Biology.' What are the entity types?
mc.e: Specific subjects are entities of the entity type Subject.
mc.ez: Physics 等是 Subject 的实体，不是实体类型。

mc.q: 'Departments are managed by managers.' With X = Department and Y = Manager, the relationship is
mc.e: Passive voice: X is managed by Y.

mc.q: STUDENT.CID references CLUB, which holds CID values 1, 2, 3, 4. A student need not join any club. What is the domain of STUDENT.CID?
mc.e: Values come from CLUB.CID, plus NULL for no club.

mc.q: Which set of attribute and domain is NOT reasonable?
o: Region: one of {'New Territories', 'Kowloon', 'Hong Kong Island'}
mc.e: Exchange rates are real numbers and can be below 1 or above 10.
mc.ez: 汇率应为实数，可小于1或大于10。

mc.q: Which set of attribute and domain is NOT reasonable?
o: Age of a bar customer: an integer at least 18
Job title: a string of 60 characters at most
Day of the week: a date within {'1970-01-01' .. '2099-12-31'}
mc.e: A day of the week is not a date.

mc.q: A student ID is a 6-digit number and some IDs start with 0. The most suitable data type is
mc.e: Leading zeros are lost if stored as an integer.

mc.q: A field stores a phone number such as 3320-2310. The most suitable data type is
mc.e: It contains '-' and no arithmetic is done on it.

mc.q: Which data type is most suitable for a field PAID that records whether a student has paid?
mc.e: Yes/no values → Boolean.

mc.q:
What does the following SQLite query return?
SELECT CAST('007512' AS INTEGER)
mc.e: Casting to integer drops the leading zeros, so 7512.
mc.ez: 转整数后前导零消失，得 7512。

mc.q: Which keyword declares a variable-length string of at most 40 characters?
mc.e: VARCHAR(n) is variable length; CHAR(n) is fixed length.

mc.q: A DATE value occupies about
mc.e: DATE: 3 bytes (Table 4.7).

mc.q: What is a database schema?
o: A backup file of a database
A text string that describes a database table
The index table of a field
A rule that checks domain values
mc.e: Schema: TABLE (FIELD1, FIELD2, ...).
mc.ez: Schema 是描述表的文字串。

mc.q: In a schema such as STUDENT (SID, NAME, CLASS), which key is usually underlined?
mc.e: The primary key is underlined.

mc.q: Which statement about a candidate key is NOT correct?
o: It stores unique data for every record
It may consist of more than one field
mc.e: A candidate key cannot be NULL.

mc.q: NAME in STUDENT currently has no duplicated values. Why is it still not a candidate key?
o: Two students may share the same name
mc.e: Uniqueness must hold for all possible data.

mc.q: Which statement about NULL is correct?
o: NULL has the data type integer
NULL means no data is stored and has no data type
NULL is the same as an empty string in every DBMS
mc.e: NULL is no data; 0 is an integer or real number.

mc.q: Table T has SCORE values 80, 0 and NULL. What does SELECT AVG(SCORE) FROM T return?
mc.e: AVG ignores NULL but counts 0: (80+0)/2 = 40.

mc.q: In STUDENT(SID, NAME, CLASS, CNO, EMAIL), which is a composite key?
mc.e: Removing either CLASS or CNO gives duplicates; the others are not minimal or not unique.
mc.ez: CLASS+CNO 是 minimal 的复合键。

mc.q: Why is SID+EMAIL NOT a composite key?
o: SID alone is already a candidate key, so the key is not minimal
SID and EMAIL have different data types
mc.e: A composite key must be minimal.

mc.q: Which set of entity type and candidate key is correct?
o: Student: Hong Kong identity card number
mc.e: No two students share an HKID number. A not unique; B not minimal; C not unique.

mc.q: How many primary keys can a table have?
o: As many as its foreign keys
mc.e: Many candidate keys, but only one primary key.

mc.q: STUDENT has candidate keys SID, EMAIL and CLASS+CNO. Why is SID the best choice of primary key?
o: It does not change, while email and class number may change
It is the only key with numbers
It is a foreign key in STUDENT
mc.e: Students may change email; CLASS+CNO changes every year.

mc.q: A foreign key in table X is always
o: the primary key of another table Y
mc.e: X is the host table, Y the parent table.

mc.q: STUDENT.CID references CLUB.CID. Which is the parent table?
mc.e: The referenced table (CLUB) is the parent; STUDENT is the host.
mc.ez: 被引用的 CLUB 是 parent table。

mc.q: Which statement about foreign keys is correct?
o: A table can have at most one foreign key
A foreign key value can never be NULL
A table can have more than one foreign key
A foreign key must be unique in the host table
mc.e: e.g. GAME has PID and GID.

mc.q: Club data is stored in CLUB and STUDENT stores only CID. Which is an advantage?
o: Club teacher changes need updating only in CLUB
CID can be NULL in CLUB
mc.e: STUDENT need not be updated when club details change.
mc.ez: 学会资料改了只需改 CLUB。

mc.q: STUDENTCLUB stores student and club details in one table; 3 students are in Science Club. How many records must be updated to change Science Club's teacher?
mc.e: Every Science Club student's record holds the teacher.

mc.q: GAME(ID, NAME, PNAME, GID, WEBSITE, PHONE, PRICE). After moving publisher data to PUBLISHER(ID, NAME, WEBSITE, PHONE), which fields remain in GAME?
mc.e: PNAME, WEBSITE, PHONE describe publishers and are replaced by PID.

mc.q: Instead of changing PRICE during a 2-week sale, a field DISCOUNT is added. What is the main advantage?
o: The original price is kept and can be restored by setting DISCOUNT to 0
PRICE can become a primary key
mc.e: Overwriting PRICE would lose the original price.

mc.q: What does indexing a field create?
o: A copy of the whole table sorted by that field
An index table containing the indexed field and pointers to the related records
mc.e: Only the indexed field plus a pointer is stored.

mc.q: Why can a DBMS use binary search on an indexed field?
o: The index table is sorted by that field
The field is a primary key
mc.e: Binary search needs sorted data.

mc.q: Which is a disadvantage of indexing a field?
o: The index takes storage space and must be updated when data changes
The field can no longer be updated
The field must become the primary key
mc.e: Updating the index takes time; it also takes storage.

mc.q: An index table has 15 sorted entries. In the worst case, how many searches does binary search need?
An index table has 1000 sorted entries. In the worst case, how many searches does binary search need?
15 book titles are in a sorted index. Using binary search with middle = (low+high) div 2, how many searches are needed to find the 14th title?
mc.e: Positions checked: 8, 12, 14.

mc.q: Which fields are most suitable to index?
o: Fields that are updated very often but rarely searched
mc.e: Only frequently searched fields should be indexed.
mc.ez: 只为常搜寻的字段建索引。

mc.q: Entity integrity is concerned with
o: the validity of the foreign key
the existence and validity of the primary key
the data types of the attributes
mc.e: Table 4.17.

mc.q: Referential integrity is concerned with
o: the validity of the foreign key
the primary key not being NULL
mc.e: Table 4.17.

mc.q: Domain integrity is concerned with
o: the data types and constraints of the attributes
mc.e: Table 4.17.
mc.ez: 域完整性关注数据类型和约束。

mc.q: Which situation violates entity integrity?
o: A foreign key value is NULL
The primary key contains a duplicated value
mc.e: Primary key must be unique and not NULL.
mc.ez: 主键重复违反实体完整性。

mc.q:
SID is the primary key of STUDENT and '03493' already exists. What happens to
INSERT INTO STUDENT (SID, NAME) VALUES ('03493', 'Zoe')
mc.e: Duplicate primary key is rejected (UNIQUE constraint failed).

mc.q: Which is NOT stopped by referential integrity on STUDENT.CID → CLUB.CID?
o: Inserting a student with a CID not in CLUB
Deleting a club referenced by students
Inserting a student with CID NULL
Changing a referenced CLUB.CID to a new value
mc.e: NULL foreign keys are allowed.

mc.q: CLUB has CIDs 1 to 4; students reference CIDs 1, 2 and 4 only. With foreign keys enforced, which statement succeeds?
o: UPDATE CLUB SET CID = 9 WHERE CID = 4
mc.e: CID 3 is not referenced, so it can be deleted.

mc.q: A table has CHECK (CNO BETWEEN 1 AND 30). Which value of CNO is accepted?
mc.e: BETWEEN is inclusive.

mc.q: Given CHECK (LENGTH(SID) = 5), which SID is accepted?
mc.e: Exactly 5 characters.

mc.q: A shop record has CLOSE = '20:90'. Which integrity is violated?
mc.e: 20:90 is not a valid time.

mc.q: A table has fields CLASS, CLASSNO, GENDER, SNAME and every field (and CLASS+CLASSNO) contains duplicates. Which integrity is most likely violated?
mc.e: No possible primary key.

mc.q: STUDENT has SROW = 'S' though rows are 1 to 5, and CID 3169 which is not in CLUB; SCLN+SROW can be the primary key. Which integrities are violated?
mc.e: Referential (3169) and domain ('S').
mc.ez: 参照完整性及域完整性。

mc.q: A shop is removed from SHOP, and PRODUCT.SID references SHOP. To keep referential integrity, what should be done?
o: Remove (or reassign) the products sold at that shop
Remove the primary key of SHOP
mc.e: Products referencing the removed shop must go too.

mc.q: An online form allows only numbers to be entered for menu choices. This data control mainly maintains
mc.e: Validation keeps values inside the domain.
mc.ez: 验证输入值属域完整性。

mc.q: In SQLite, which statement must be run so foreign key constraints are enforced?
mc.e: SQLite enforces FKs only when the pragma is on.

mc.q: What is a rollback?
o: Restoring a database to its previous state
mc.e: Definition from 4.4.

mc.q: Why must a database be backed up regularly?
o: So that it can be rolled back if errors corrupt the data
mc.e: Backups make rollback possible.

mc.q:
STUDENT has 3 students in 6A and 7 in 5A. A teacher runs
UPDATE STUDENT SET CLASS = '6A' WHERE CLASS = '5A';
DELETE FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS = '6A';
How many records remain?
mc.e: All 10 become 6A, then all are deleted.

mc.q: Which command exports database SCHOOL to school.sql?
mc.e: mysqldump exports with >; mysql imports with <.

mc.q: Which command restores school.sql into database SCHOOL?
mc.e: mysql runs a SQL file.
mc.ez: mysql 执行 SQL 文件还原。

mc.q: A file made by mysqldump mainly contains
o: SQL statements such as CREATE TABLE and INSERT INTO
mc.e: They recreate the tables with the same data.
mc.ez: 含 CREATE TABLE 和 INSERT INTO。

mc.q: A program updating 10,000 payments in ACCOUNT stopped halfway at an unknown point. What should the administrator do?
o: Run the program again from the start immediately
Roll back the database to the state before the program ran, then rerun
mc.e: Some payments may be half done; rerunning would double some.
ROLLBACK undoes the delete.

mc.q: If the command prompt says 'mysqldump' is not recognized, what should you check?
o: The PATH environment variable includes the MySQL bin folder
The table has a primary key
mc.e: Lab 4.1 note.
mc.ez: 把 MySQL bin 加到 PATH。

sq.q:
A secondary school teacher created two tables A and B to store data of school events and student participants. Students are aged 11 to 18.
ADescription
EIDUnique identity number of each event
ENAMEName of the event
EDATEDate of the event
FEEParticipation fee in dollars, e.g. 34.5
FINISHEDWhether the event has finished
BDescription
SIDUnique 6-digit identity number of each student; some start with zeros
EIDIdentity number of the event the student participates in
AGEAge of the student
PAIDWhether the student has paid the fee

parts.q: State the entity types of A and B.
parts.ms: School events and students respectively [1]

parts.q: Suggest a data type for EID, EDATE and FEE in A.
parts.ms:
EID: integer / characters; EDATE: date [1]
FEE: real / float (34.5 has a decimal part) [1]

parts.q: Suggest a data type for SID and PAID in B. Explain your choice for SID.
parts.ms:
SID: characters, since it may start with 0 and leading zeros would be lost as an integer [1]
PAID: Boolean [1]

parts.q: What is the domain of AGE?
What is the relationship between the entity types of A and B?
parts.ms: B participates in A / students participate in school events [1]

sq.q:
A manager created tables A and B.
A(PID, PNAME, STOCK, PRICE, SID): products, with SID being the shop that sells them.
B(SID, SNAME, OPEN, CLOSE, BHOUR): shops, with daily opening time, closing time and business hours.

parts.q: State the entity types of A and B.
parts.ms: Products and shops respectively [1]

parts.q: Suggest a data type for PNAME, STOCK and PRICE.
parts.ms:
PNAME: characters; STOCK: integer [1]
PRICE: real / float [1]

parts.q: Which field of B is a derived attribute? Explain briefly.
parts.ms:
BHOUR [1]
It is the time difference between OPEN and CLOSE, so it can be calculated [1]

parts.q: What is the domain of OPEN?
What is the relationship between the entity types of A and B?
parts.ms: B sells A / A is sold by B [1]

sq.q: BOOK(ISBN, BNAME, ANAME, ANAT, AAGE, PDATE, PAGE, PRICE, PID) stores books, including author name, nationality and age. PUBLISHER(PID, PNAME, PHONE, LOCATION) stores publishers.

parts.q: Write the schemas of BOOK and PUBLISHER. Underline the primary keys and state the foreign keys.
parts.ms:
BOOK (ISBN, BNAME, ANAME, ANAT, AAGE, PDATE, PAGE, PRICE, PID), Foreign key: PID [1]
PUBLISHER (PID, PNAME, PHONE, LOCATION), Foreign key: N/A [1]

parts.q: Suggest data types for PDATE, PAGE and PRICE.
parts.ms:
PDATE: date; PAGE: integer [1]
PRICE: real / float [1]

parts.q: A table AUTHOR is created with identity code AID; data relating to authors is removed from BOOK. Write the updated schema of BOOK and the schema of AUTHOR.
parts.ms:
BOOK (ISBN, BNAME, AID, PDATE, PAGE, PRICE, PID), Foreign key: AID, PID [1]
AUTHOR (AID, ANAME, ANAT, AAGE), Foreign key: N/A [1]

parts.q: State one advantage of storing authors' birthdays instead of ages.
parts.ms:
Age changes every year but birthday does not [1]
so the data need not be updated frequently; age can be calculated from the birthday [1]

sq.q: A video game platform uses GAME(ID, NAME, PNAME, GID, WEBSITE, PHONE, PRICE) and GENRE(ID, NAME, RES). PNAME, WEBSITE and PHONE describe the publisher; PHONE is e.g. 3320-2310; PRICE is e.g. 30.9.

parts.q: Write the schemas of GAME and GENRE, underlining primary keys and stating foreign keys.
parts.ms:
GAME (ID, NAME, PNAME, GID, WEBSITE, PHONE, PRICE), Foreign key: GID [1]
GENRE (ID, NAME, RES), Foreign key: N/A [1]

parts.q: Suggest data types for PHONE and PRICE with reasons.
parts.ms:
PHONE: characters, contains '-' and no calculation [1]
PRICE: real / float, e.g. 30.9 [1]

parts.q: A table PUBLISHER with identity code is created. Write the updated GAME schema and the PUBLISHER schema.
parts.ms:
GAME (ID, NAME, PID, GID, PRICE), Foreign key: PID, GID [1]
PUBLISHER (ID, NAME, WEBSITE, PHONE), Foreign key: N/A [1]

parts.q: A two-week discount is given. The administrator adds a field DISCOUNT instead of updating PRICE. State one advantage.
parts.ms:
The original price is not lost [1]
After two weeks, DISCOUNT can simply be set to 0 to restore the original prices [1]

sq.q: STUDENT(SID, NAME, HKID, CLASS, CNO, EMAIL) stores students of ABC Secondary School. SID is a student identity code; EMAIL is a personal email address.

parts.q: List all candidate keys of STUDENT.
parts.ms:
SID, HKID, EMAIL [1]
CLASS + CNO (composite key) [1]

parts.q: Explain why NAME is not a candidate key even if no two current students share a name.
parts.ms: Two students may share the same name in future, so uniqueness is not guaranteed [1]

parts.q: Explain why SID + EMAIL is not a composite key.
parts.ms: It is not minimal: SID alone is already unique, so removing EMAIL gives no duplicates [1]

parts.q: Which candidate key should be the primary key? Give a reason by comparing with EMAIL and CLASS + CNO.
parts.ms:
SID [1]
Email may be changed by the student and CLASS + CNO usually changes every year, while SID does not change [1]

sq.q: Index table on BNAME of 15 books (sorted alphabetically), with binary search using middle = (low + high) div 2.

parts.q: State why an index allows binary search.
parts.ms: The indexed field in the index table is sorted [1]

parts.q: How many searches are needed to find the 8th title and the 14th title?
parts.ms:
8th: 1 search [1]
14th: 3 searches (8, 12, 14) [1]

parts.q: In the worst case, how many searches are needed for 15 titles, and for 1000 titles?
Why should we not index all fields in a table?
parts.ms:
Each index table takes extra storage space [1]
The index must be updated when indexed data changes or records are added, which takes time [1]

sq.q: PRODUCT(PID, PNAME, STOCK, PRICE), SHOP(SNAME, ADDRESS, OPEN, CLOSE, OID), OWNER(OID, ONAME, OPHONE). One SHOP record has OPEN 09:30 and CLOSE 20:90.

parts.q: Based on the data, which type of integrity is violated? Explain briefly.
parts.ms:
Domain integrity [1]
20:90 is not a valid time / outside the domain of CLOSE [1]

parts.q: SHOP has no primary key defined. Which type of integrity does it violate?
parts.ms: Entity integrity [1]

parts.q: Suggest a primary key for SHOP and explain.
parts.ms:
ADDRESS [1]
No two shops share the same full address [1]

parts.q: SHOP's primary key is used as a foreign key in PRODUCT to show where products are sold. To maintain referential integrity, what should be done if a record in SHOP is removed?
parts.ms: The records of all products sold at the removed shop should be removed as well [1]

sq.q: A football contest uses PLAYER(PNAME, TID, TNAME, SNO, POS), TEAM(TID, TNAME, GID, PTS) and GROUP(GID, GNAME). SNO (squad number) is unique within a team.

parts.q: State the primary key and foreign key (or N/A) of each table.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: PLAYER: PK TID + SNO, FK TID [1]
TEAM: PK TID, FK GID [1]
GROUP: PK GID, FK N/A [1]

parts.q: One attribute in PLAYER is redundant. Which one? Explain briefly.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: TNAME [1]
It can be obtained from TEAM using TID, and storing it again may cause inconsistency [1]

parts.q: A team withdraws and the organiser deletes its TEAM record without further action. Which integrity may be violated? How can it be fixed?
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Referential integrity: PLAYER records still reference the deleted TID [1]
Delete (or update) the related PLAYER records of that team [1]

parts.q: Positions can be Goalkeeper, Defender, Midfielder or Forward. A record has POS 'Attacker'. Which integrity is violated?
parts.ms: Suggested answer: Domain integrity [1]

parts.q: A table POSITION(POS, POSTYPE) maps 0–3 to the four positions and PLAYER.POS becomes an integer foreign key. Give two advantages when PLAYER has over 30000 records.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Less storage: integers are shorter than repeated strings [1]
Changing a position's name updates one row in POSITION only / invalid or misspelt positions are prevented [1]

sq.src: Textbook EA Ch4 Chapter Exercise Q2 (p.239), based on DSE 2012 2A Q1

sq.q: Steven stores actors and films: ACTOR(AID, ANAME, SEX, AGE, FID) and FILM(FID, FNAME, FYEAR). SEX is Boolean.

parts.q: State the relationship between ACTOR and FILM in one sentence.
parts.ms: Suggested answer: Actors star in films [1]

parts.q: What is the domain of SEX?
parts.ms: Suggested answer: {TRUE, FALSE} / {0, 1} [1]

parts.q: Steven removes FID from ACTOR and creates STARRING(FID, AID, CTYPE, ROLE). Why?
parts.ms: Suggested answer: An actor can star in many films (and a film has many actors); one FID field allows only one film per actor [1]

parts.q: A website lets users search films by name, actors by name, and view films by year. Which fields should be indexed?
parts.ms: Suggested answer: FNAME, ANAME and FYEAR [1]

parts.q: A film was removed from FILM and its STARRING records were also removed. Later the film must be added back but the STARRING data is not remembered. Suggest one action.
parts.ms: Suggested answer: Roll back / restore the database (or those tables) from a backup made before the deletion [1]

sq.src: Textbook EA Ch4 Chapter Exercise Q3 (p.240), based on DSE 2014 2A Q2

sq.q: PAYMENT(TID, PAYERID, PAYEEID, AMOUNT, TTIME) and ACCOUNT(AID, UNAME, DEPOSIT). PAYERID and PAYEEID refer to accounts.

parts.q: Write the schema of PAYMENT, underlining the primary key and stating the foreign keys.
parts.ms:
PAYMENT (TID, PAYERID, PAYEEID, AMOUNT, TTIME) [1]
Foreign key: PAYERID, PAYEEID [1]

parts.q: After a payment is made, how should ACCOUNT be updated?
parts.ms:
The payer's deposit is reduced by the amount [1]
The payee's deposit is increased by the amount [1]

parts.q: A program updating ACCOUNT for 10,000 payments was aborted at an unknown point. What should the administrator do? Explain why.
parts.ms:
Roll back the database to the previous state (before the program ran) and rerun [1]
Some payments may be halfway done, e.g. payer deducted but payee not credited, so data is inconsistent [1]

sq.q: STUDENT(SID, NAME, SEX, CLASS) holds 3 students in 6A and 7 students in 5A. At a new school year a teacher wants to remove 6A students and promote 5A students to 6A.

parts.q: Write the two SQL statements in the correct order.
parts.ms:
DELETE FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS = '6A' [1]
then UPDATE STUDENT SET CLASS = '6A' WHERE CLASS = '5A' [1]

parts.q: The teacher runs them in the reverse order. Describe the result.
parts.ms:
All 5A students become 6A first [1]
then all 6A students are deleted, leaving the table empty (0 records) [1]

parts.q: Define rollback and state what must be done regularly so a rollback is possible.
parts.ms:
Rollback: restoring a database to its previous state [1]
Back up the database regularly [1]

parts.q: Write the MySQL commands to back up database SCHOOL to school.sql as user root, and to restore it.
parts.ms:
mysqldump -u root -p SCHOOL > school.sql [1]
mysql -u root -p -h localhost SCHOOL < school.sql [1]

sq.q: Ms Chan's tea-party order form stores data in MEALORDER(ENAME, AGE, APPETISER, MAINCOURSE, NEEDCUTLERY). AGE has data type p and NEEDCUTLERY data type q.

parts.q: Mr Lee says MEALORDER violates a type of integrity. State it and explain.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Entity integrity [1]
There is no primary key / no field is guaranteed unique, e.g. two employees may share a name [1]

parts.q: Fix the problem and write the schema of MEALORDER.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Add a field OID (order identity code) [1]
MEALORDER (OID, ENAME, AGE, APPETISER, MAINCOURSE, NEEDCUTLERY) [1]

parts.q: Apart from character, suggest reasonable data types for p and q.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: p: integer [1]
q: Boolean [1]

parts.q: The form only allows numbers for appetiser and main course choices. What kind of data control is it, and which integrity does it maintain?
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Validation (e.g. type / range check) [1]
Domain integrity [1]

parts.q: The menu often changes and every record had to be updated. How could this mass update have been prevented?
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Store menu items in a separate table (e.g. MENU(MID, MNAME)) [1]
and store only the item code in MEALORDER as a foreign key, so a change updates one record in MENU [1]

sq.src: Textbook EA Ch4 Chapter Exercise Q1 (p.238), based on DSE 2012 Practice Paper 2A Q4

pr.task: Tables STUDENT(SID, NAME, SEX, CLASS, CID) and CLUB(CID, NAME, ROOM, TEACH) are loaded. STUDENT.CID is a foreign key referencing CLUB.CID. List each student's NAME together with the NAME of the club they joined (column alias CNAME). Students with no club are not shown.
pr.taskz: 已载入 STUDENT 和 CLUB。STUDENT.CID 是引用 CLUB.CID 的外键。列出每位学生的 NAME 和所参加学会的名称（别名 CNAME），没参加学会的不用显示。
pr.solution: SELECT S.NAME, C.NAME AS CNAME FROM STUDENT S, CLUB C WHERE S.CID = C.CID;

check.expected_sql: SELECT S.NAME, C.NAME AS CNAME FROM STUDENT S, CLUB C WHERE S.CID = C.CID;

pr.task: Using STUDENT and CLUB, show every club's NAME and the number of students in it (alias NUM), including clubs with no members (NUM = 0). This shows why keeping CLUB as a separate table is useful: English Club's data is kept even though no student has joined.
pr.taskz: 用 STUDENT 和 CLUB 显示每个学会的 NAME 及人数（别名 NUM），没有成员的学会也要显示（NUM = 0）。可见独立的 CLUB 表能保留没有成员的学会资料。
pr.solution: SELECT C.NAME, COUNT(S.SID) AS NUM FROM CLUB C LEFT JOIN STUDENT S ON C.CID = S.CID GROUP BY C.CID, C.NAME;

check.expected_sql: SELECT C.NAME, COUNT(S.SID) AS NUM FROM CLUB C LEFT JOIN STUDENT S ON C.CID = S.CID GROUP BY C.CID, C.NAME;

pr.task: PRODUCT(PID, PNAME, PRICE, COST) does not store profit, because profit is a derived attribute. Write a query showing PNAME and PROFIT (= PRICE − COST, rounded to 1 decimal place with ROUND) for every product, ordered by PROFIT from highest to lowest.
pr.taskz: PRODUCT 不储存利润，因为利润是衍生属性。写查询显示每件产品的 PNAME 和 PROFIT（= PRICE − COST，用 ROUND 取 1 位小数），按 PROFIT 由高到低排序。
pr.setup:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (PID CHAR(4) PRIMARY KEY, PNAME VARCHAR(30), PRICE FLOAT, COST FLOAT);
INSERT INTO PRODUCT VALUES ('P001','Pencil',5.5,2.0),('P002','Ruler',12.0,7.5),('P003','Eraser',4.0,1.2),('P004','Notebook',18.9,11.0),('P005','Glue',9.0,9.5);
pr.solution: SELECT PNAME, ROUND(PRICE - COST, 1) AS PROFIT FROM PRODUCT ORDER BY PROFIT DESC;

check.expected_sql: SELECT PNAME, ROUND(PRICE - COST, 1) AS PROFIT FROM PRODUCT ORDER BY PROFIT DESC;

pr.task: AUTHOR(AID, ANAME, DOB) stores birthdays instead of ages, because age changes every year. Show ANAME and the author's AGE in whole years on the date 2026-09-01. Hint (SQLite): CAST((julianday('2026-09-01') - julianday(DOB)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER). (In MySQL you would use TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, DOB, '2026-09-01').)
pr.taskz: AUTHOR 储存生日而非年龄。显示 ANAME 及在 2026-09-01 时的整数年龄 AGE。提示（SQLite）：CAST((julianday('2026-09-01') - julianday(DOB)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER)（MySQL 可用 TIMESTAMPDIFF）。
pr.setup:
CREATE TABLE AUTHOR (AID INT PRIMARY KEY, ANAME VARCHAR(40), DOB DATE);
INSERT INTO AUTHOR VALUES (1,'Amy Chan','1980-03-15'),(2,'Tom Ho','1995-11-02'),(3,'Kelly Lam','2001-01-20'),(4,'Peter Wu','1972-09-10');
pr.solution: SELECT ANAME, CAST((julianday('2026-09-01') - julianday(DOB)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS AGE FROM AUTHOR;

check.expected_sql: SELECT ANAME, CAST((julianday('2026-09-01') - julianday(DOB)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS AGE FROM AUTHOR;

pr.t: Why NAME is not a candidate key
pr.tz: 为何 NAME 不是候选键
pr.task: A candidate key must store unique data. Write a query that finds every NAME that appears more than once in STUDENT, with the number of times (alias CNT).
pr.taskz: 候选键必须唯一。写查询找出在 STUDENT 中出现多于一次的 NAME，以及出现次数（别名 CNT）。
pr.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(40), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT, EMAIL VARCHAR(40));
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','3A',1,'ada@abcss.edu.hk'),('03496','Clem','3B',15,'clem@abcss.edu.hk'),('03505','Eva','3B',28,'eva@abcss.edu.hk'),('03506','Gabe','3C',15,'gabe@abcss.edu.hk'),('03510','Finn','3B',7,'finn@abcss.edu.hk'),('03513','Ada','3C',12,'ada2@abcss.edu.hk'),('03517','Ben','3A',9,'ben@abcss.edu.hk');
pr.solution: SELECT NAME, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM STUDENT GROUP BY NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

check.expected_sql: SELECT NAME, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM STUDENT GROUP BY NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

pr.t: CNO alone is not a key
pr.task: CLASS+CNO is a composite key because removing either field gives duplicates. Write a query listing each CNO value shared by more than one student, with the number of students (alias CNT).
pr.taskz: CLASS+CNO 是复合键，因为拿走任何一个字段都会重复。写查询列出被多于一位学生共用的 CNO 及人数（别名 CNT）。
pr.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(40), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT, EMAIL VARCHAR(40));
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','3A',1,'ada@abcss.edu.hk'),('03496','Clem','3B',15,'clem@abcss.edu.hk'),('03505','Eva','3B',28,'eva@abcss.edu.hk'),('03506','Gabe','3C',15,'gabe@abcss.edu.hk'),('03510','Finn','3B',7,'finn@abcss.edu.hk'),('03513','Ada','3C',12,'ada2@abcss.edu.hk'),('03517','Ben','3A',9,'ben@abcss.edu.hk');
pr.solution: SELECT CNO, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM STUDENT GROUP BY CNO HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

check.expected_sql: SELECT CNO, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM STUDENT GROUP BY CNO HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

pr.tz: 找出违反参照完整性的记录
pr.task: Foreign keys were not enforced and some bad data got in. List SID, NAME and CID of students whose CID is not NULL but does not exist in CLUB.
pr.taskz: 外键没有被强制，混入了错误数据。列出 CID 不是 NULL 但在 CLUB 中不存在的学生的 SID、NAME、CID。
pr.solution: SELECT SID, NAME, CID FROM STUDENT WHERE CID IS NOT NULL AND CID NOT IN (SELECT CID FROM CLUB);

check.expected_sql: SELECT SID, NAME, CID FROM STUDENT WHERE CID IS NOT NULL AND CID NOT IN (SELECT CID FROM CLUB);

pr.tz: 找出违反实体完整性的记录
pr.task: SID is meant to be the primary key of this table, but no primary key was defined. List the distinct SID values that appear more than once (alias SID) so they can be fixed. (Then also think: which record breaks entity integrity because its SID is NULL?)
pr.taskz: SID 本应是主键，但没有定义。列出出现多于一次的 SID（不重复列出），以便修正。（再想想：哪条记录因 SID 为 NULL 而违反实体完整性？）
pr.setup:
CREATE TABLE ENROL (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(40), SUBJECT VARCHAR(20));
INSERT INTO ENROL VALUES ('03493','Ada','ICT'),('03496','Clem','M2'),('03493','Ada2','Physics'),(NULL,'Gabe','ICT'),('03510','Finn','ICT'),('03510','Finn','Chem'),('03517','Ben','ICT');
pr.solution: SELECT SID FROM ENROL WHERE SID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

check.expected_sql: SELECT SID FROM ENROL WHERE SID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

pr.tz: 找出违反域完整性的记录
pr.task: Domains: SID is exactly 5 characters; SEX in {'M','F'}; CLASS in {'1A','1B','1C','1D'}; CNO in {1 .. 30}. List the SID and NAME of every record that breaks at least one of these domains.
pr.taskz: Domain：SID 刚好 5 个字符；SEX ∈ {'M','F'}；CLASS ∈ {'1A','1B','1C','1D'}；CNO ∈ {1 .. 30}。列出违反至少一个 domain 的记录的 SID 和 NAME。
pr.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(40), SEX CHAR(1), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT);
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','F','1A',1),('0349','Clem','F','1B',15),('03505','Eva','X','1B',28),('03506','Gabe','M','1E',15),('03510','Finn','M','1B',31),('03513','Dio','M','1C',12),('03517','Ben','M','1A',0);
pr.solution: SELECT SID, NAME FROM STUDENT WHERE LENGTH(SID) <> 5 OR SEX NOT IN ('M','F') OR CLASS NOT IN ('1A','1B','1C','1D') OR CNO NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 30;

check.expected_sql: SELECT SID, NAME FROM STUDENT WHERE LENGTH(SID) <> 5 OR SEX NOT IN ('M','F') OR CLASS NOT IN ('1A','1B','1C','1D') OR CNO NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 30;

pr.tz: 用 DISCOUNT 计算最终价
pr.task: Instead of overwriting PRICE during a sale, GAME has a DISCOUNT field (0.2 = 20% off). Show NAME and FINAL = PRICE × (1 − DISCOUNT), rounded to 2 decimal places, for the games of publisher PID = 7 only.
pr.taskz: 促销时不覆盖 PRICE，而用 DISCOUNT 字段（0.2 = 八折）。只显示出版商 PID = 7 的游戏的 NAME 及 FINAL = PRICE × (1 − DISCOUNT)，取 2 位小数。
pr.setup:
CREATE TABLE GAME (ID INT PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR(40), PID INT, PRICE FLOAT, DISCOUNT FLOAT);
INSERT INTO GAME VALUES (1,'Sky Racer',7,30.9,0.2),(2,'Pixel Farm',3,45.0,0),(3,'Moon Base',7,60.0,0.5),(4,'Word Duel',5,12.5,0),(5,'Robo Chess',7,25.0,0.1);
pr.solution: SELECT NAME, ROUND(PRICE * (1 - DISCOUNT), 2) AS FINAL FROM GAME WHERE PID = 7;

check.expected_sql: SELECT NAME, ROUND(PRICE * (1 - DISCOUNT), 2) AS FINAL FROM GAME WHERE PID = 7;

pr.tz: 通过 STARRING 处理多对多
pr.task: ACTOR(AID, ANAME), FILM(FID, FNAME, FYEAR) and STARRING(FID, AID, CTYPE, ROLE) are loaded. List FNAME and ANAME for every main character (CTYPE = 'Main character'), ordered by FNAME then ANAME.
pr.taskz: 已载入 ACTOR、FILM、STARRING。列出所有 CTYPE = 'Main character' 的 FNAME 和 ANAME，按 FNAME 再按 ANAME 排序。
pr.solution: SELECT F.FNAME, A.ANAME FROM FILM F, STARRING S, ACTOR A WHERE F.FID = S.FID AND S.AID = A.AID AND S.CTYPE = 'Main character' ORDER BY F.FNAME, A.ANAME;

check.expected_sql: SELECT F.FNAME, A.ANAME FROM FILM F, STARRING S, ACTOR A WHERE F.FID = S.FID AND S.AID = A.AID AND S.CTYPE = 'Main character' ORDER BY F.FNAME, A.ANAME;

pr.t: Promote a class in the right order
pr.task: New school year: remove the 6A students, then promote every 5A student to 6A. Write the two statements in the correct order, then finish with SELECT SID, NAME, CLASS FROM STUDENT ORDER BY SID; (the result of this last SELECT is checked). Try the wrong order too and see the table become empty: that is when a rollback is needed.
pr.taskz: 新学年：先删除 6A 学生，再把 5A 学生升到 6A。按正确次序写出两条语句，最后加上 SELECT SID, NAME, CLASS FROM STUDENT ORDER BY SID;（检查这条 SELECT 的结果）。也试试错误次序，看表变空，这时就需要 rollback。

pr.task: Write CREATE TABLE statements for CLUB(CID, NAME, ROOM) and STUDENT(SID, NAME, SEX, CLASS, CNO, CID) that enforce: entity integrity (primary keys), referential integrity (STUDENT.CID references CLUB) and domain integrity (SID exactly 5 characters, SEX in M/F, CLASS in 1A–1D, CNO 1 to 30). Then insert one valid club and one valid student. Compare with the model answer.
pr.taskz: 写 CLUB 和 STUDENT 的 CREATE TABLE，要求：实体完整性（主键）、参照完整性（STUDENT.CID 引用 CLUB）、域完整性（SID 5 个字符、SEX 为 M/F、CLASS 为 1A–1D、CNO 1–30）。再插入一个有效学会和一个有效学生，与参考答案比较。

check.model: Model answer: CLUB has CID as PRIMARY KEY. STUDENT has SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY (entity integrity); CHECK constraints LENGTH(SID) = 5, SEX IN ('M','F'), CLASS IN ('1A','1B','1C','1D'), CNO BETWEEN 1 AND 30 (domain integrity); FOREIGN KEY (CID) REFERENCES CLUB(CID) (referential integrity). Insert the club before the student, because the student's CID must already exist in CLUB. In SQLite, run PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; for the foreign key to be enforced.

pr.t: Split a table and write schemas
pr.task: BOOK(ISBN, BNAME, ANAME, ANAT, AAGE, PDATE, PAGE, PRICE, PID) stores author data inside every book record. Design an improved structure: write the schemas (mark the primary key) and CREATE TABLE statements for BOOK and a new AUTHOR table, storing the author's date of birth instead of age.
pr.taskz: BOOK 每条记录都重复存作者资料。设计改良结构：写出 BOOK 及新 AUTHOR 表的 schema（标明主键）和 CREATE TABLE，作者改存出生日期而非年龄。
pr.solution:
CREATE TABLE AUTHOR (
  AID INT PRIMARY KEY,
  ANAME VARCHAR(40),
  ANAT VARCHAR(30),
  DOB DATE
);
CREATE TABLE BOOK (
  ISBN CHAR(13) PRIMARY KEY,
  BNAME VARCHAR(100),
  AID INT,
  PDATE DATE,
  PAGE INT,
  PRICE FLOAT,
  PID INT,
  FOREIGN KEY (AID) REFERENCES AUTHOR(AID)
);

check.model:
Model answer:
BOOK (ISBN, BNAME, AID, PDATE, PAGE, PRICE, PID), Foreign key: AID, PID
AUTHOR (AID, ANAME, ANAT, DOB), Foreign key: N/A
Key points: author fields move to AUTHOR with a new identity code AID; BOOK keeps only AID as a foreign key; DOB is stored because age is a derived attribute that changes every year; ISBN is characters (may contain leading zeros / hyphens); PRICE is real.

chs.tz: 数据库设计与 ER 图

cards.tz: 好的与坏的数据库设计
cards.en:
A well-designed database is essential for managing large amounts of data. A good design should be organised, efficient and easy to use: tables are clear and concise, each table contains only the necessary data, and tables are related to each other in a logical way.

A poorly designed database can cause slow performance, data inconsistencies and difficulties in retrieving data. Poorly organised tables lead to redundant or incomplete data, which makes data harder to manage and analyse.

To get a good design we must plan and organise the tables properly and follow established principles. This chapter gives two main tools: the ER diagram (to plan entity types, attributes and relationships before building tables) and normalisation (to remove redundancy and anomalies). Later we also see when denormalisation is used on purpose, and how to protect data privacy.
cards.zh:
好的数据库设计是管理大量数据的基础。好设计应该 organised, efficient and easy to use：表 clear and concise，每个表只存 necessary data，表与表之间有 logical relationship。

坏的设计会带来：slow performance（慢）、data inconsistencies（数据不一致）、difficulties in retrieving data（难查询）；组织不好的表会有 redundant or incomplete data（冗余或不完整数据），难管理和分析。

做法：plan and organise the tables properly，遵循设计原则。本章两大工具：ER diagram（建表前先规划实体、属性、关系）和 normalisation（去除冗余和异常）。之后还会讲有意的 denormalisation 和 data privacy。

ex.q: A shop keeps one big table where every sale record repeats the customer's name, address and phone. Give two problems of this design.
ex.a:
1. Data redundancy: the same address is stored many times, wasting storage.
2. Data inconsistency: if the customer moves, every record must be changed; if some are missed, the database holds two different addresses (update anomaly).
A better design stores customers in a separate CUSTOMER table and links each sale by a foreign key.
ex.az: 冗余浪费空间；客户搬家要改很多条，漏改就不一致。应拆出 CUSTOMER 表，用外键连接。

cards.en:
An Entity-Relationship diagram (ER diagram) is a diagram that represents the elements of a relational database (entity types, relationships and attributes) with shapes. It helps us decide the table structures before we create any table.

Mapping rules:
• Each entity type becomes a table.
• Each attribute of the entity type becomes a field of that table.
• The relationship tells us how tables are linked (by foreign keys, or by an extra table).

Example SCHOOL database: entity types Student and Class, joined by the relationship Belong to. Student has attributes Student ID (key) and Student name; Class has Class name (key) and Room number. Tables: STUDENT(SID, SNAME) and CLASS(CLASSNAME, ROOMNUM). Field names can be any sensible short names.
cards.zh:
ER diagram（实体关系图）：用图形表示关系数据库的元素：entity types（实体类型）, relationships（关系）, attributes（属性）。作用：建表前帮助决定 table structures。

对应规则：
• 每个 entity type → 一个 table；
• entity 的每个 attribute → 该表的一个 field；
• relationship 说明表之间怎样连（外键，或额外的表）。

例 SCHOOL：实体 Student 与 Class，关系 Belong to。Student 有 Student ID（主键）、Student name；Class 有 Class name（主键）、Room number。得 STUDENT(SID, SNAME)、CLASS(CLASSNAME, ROOMNUM)。字段名可自取合理简称。

ex.q: An ER diagram has rectangles Animal, Zone, Species; Animal has ellipses Animal name (underlined), Weight, Date of birth. (a) List all tables. (b) List the attributes of Animal and its primary key.
ex.a:
(a) One table per entity type: ANIMAL, ZONE, SPECIES.
(b) Animal name, Weight, Date of birth. The underlined attribute, Animal name, is the primary key.
ex.az: 每个长方形一个表；下划线的属性是主键。（课本 Checkpoint 5.1）

cards.en:
Each element in an ER diagram is drawn with a fixed shape:
ShapeElementRemark
RectangleEntity typebecomes a table
DiamondRelationshipnamed with a verb, e.g. Join, Belong to, Be managed by; a relationship may have attributes too
Ellipse (oval)Attributethe underlined attribute is the primary key
Lines connect attributes to their entity type, and connect entity types to the relationship diamond. Colours have no meaning; only the shapes matter.

Read a relationship as a sentence: rectangle, diamond, rectangle, e.g. "Student belongs to Class". Reading from the other side often uses the passive voice: "Zone is managed by Manager".
cards.zh:
ER 图元素的固定形状：
形状元素备注
长方形 rectangleEntity type成为一个表
菱形 diamondRelationship用动词命名，如 Join, Belong to, Be managed by；关系也可以有属性
椭圆 ellipseAttribute加下划线的是 primary key
线把属性连到实体，把实体连到菱形。颜色没有意义，只看形状。

读法：长方形—菱形—长方形当一句话，如 “Student belongs to Class”；反方向常用被动语态：“Zone is managed by Manager”。

ex.q: In an ER diagram, the oval 'Treatment date' is connected to the diamond 'Treat' between Doctor and Patient. What does this mean?
ex.a: An oval is an attribute. Because it is attached to a diamond, it is an attribute of the relationship, not of Doctor or Patient: the date belongs to one particular treatment of a patient by a doctor.
ex.az: 椭圆是属性；连在菱形上就是关系本身的属性（某医生某次治疗某病人的日期）。

cards.t: From ER diagram to table structure and schema
cards.tz: 由 ER 图写出表结构与 schema
cards.en:
Steps to turn an ER diagram into tables:
1. Each entity type (rectangle) becomes one table; give it a short upper-case name.
2. Each attribute (ellipse) becomes a field with a sensible name, e.g. Event start time → STARTTIME.
3. Choose a suitable data type: Character, Integer, Date, Time, Datetime.
4. The underlined attribute becomes the primary key.
5. Add foreign keys according to the relationships (details in 5.3).

A schema is a one-line summary of a table: CLASS(CLASSNAME, ROOMNUM) with the primary key underlined.

To add a new table to a design, draw a new rectangle with its ellipses, then draw a diamond linking it to the related entity type. Example: a new MANAGER table (Staff ID, Manager name, Phone, Working hours) is added as rectangle Manager with four ellipses (Staff ID underlined) and linked by the diamond Be managed by to Zone.
cards.zh:
由 ER 图建表步骤：
1. 每个长方形 → 一个表（大写简短表名）；
2. 每个椭圆 → 一个 field，名字合理即可，如 Event start time → STARTTIME；
3. 选 data type：Character, Integer, Date, Time, Datetime；
4. 下划线属性 → primary key；
5. 按 relationship 加 foreign key（见 5.3）。

Schema 写法：CLASS(CLASSNAME, ROOMNUM)，主键加下划线。

加新表：画新长方形和它的椭圆，再用菱形连到相关实体。例：新增 MANAGER(Staff ID, Manager name, Phone, Working hours)，画长方形 Manager + 四个椭圆（Staff ID 下划线），用菱形 Be managed by 连到 Zone。

ex.q: Entity type Event has attributes Event ID (underlined), Event name, Event start time, Venue. Write the schema and suggest data types.
ex.a:
Schema: EVENT(EID, ENAME, STARTTIME, VENUE)
Data types: EID Integer (or Character), ENAME Character, STARTTIME Datetime (or Time), VENUE Character.
CREATE TABLE EVENT (
  EID INT PRIMARY KEY,
  ENAME VARCHAR(30),
  STARTTIME DATETIME,
  VENUE VARCHAR(30)
);
ex.az: 表名 EVENT，主键 EID 加下划线；时间用 Datetime/Time。

cards.t: Foreign keys are shown by relationships
cards.tz: 外键用关系表示，不画成属性
cards.en:
A common mistake is to draw a foreign key as an ellipse attribute of an entity type. In an ER diagram, foreign keys are represented by the relationship, not by attributes.

Example: LETTER(LID, RADD, PID, MID), where PID references POSTMAN and MID references MAILBOX. In the ER diagram, the rectangle Letter has only the ellipses Letter ID and Recipient address. The links to Postman and Mailbox are drawn as diamonds (Deliver, Originate from), not as PID and MID ellipses.

Why: the diagram shows the meaning of the link; where the foreign key goes (which table) is decided when converting to tables, using cardinality (the FK goes on the many side).
cards.zh:
常见错误：把外键画成实体的椭圆属性。正确：foreign keys are represented by the relationship, not attributes。

例：LETTER(LID, RADD, PID, MID)，PID 参照 POSTMAN，MID 参照 MAILBOX。ER 图里 Letter 只画 Letter ID、Recipient address 两个椭圆；与 Postman、Mailbox 的联系画成菱形（Deliver、Originate from），不画 PID、MID 椭圆。

原因：ER 图表达联系的意义；外键放哪个表是转成表时按基数决定（外键放 many 那边）。

ex.q: PRODUCT(PID, PNAME, PRICE, SID) where SID references STORE. A student draws an ellipse 'Store ID' attached to Product. Correct it.
ex.a: Remove the 'Store ID' ellipse from Product. Instead draw a diamond Sell between Store and Product. Store keeps its own key attribute Store ID; the foreign key PRODUCT.SID is implied by the relationship (Store 1 — Sell — M Product).
ex.az: 删掉 Product 上的 Store ID 椭圆，改用菱形 Sell 连 Store 与 Product。

cards.en:
The participation constraint of a relationship specifies whether each entity of an entity type participates in a relationship or not.

Every relationship has two sides. Each side is either:
• a mandatory side: every entity must take part, or
• an optional side: an entity may or may not take part.

Symbols are drawn on the line next to the entity on the far side:
DiagramSideReading
Student — Join —| Sports eventMandatory (short bar)A student must join a sports event
Student — Join —O Sports eventOptional (small circle)A student may or may not join a sports event
Read left to right for one side, then right to left for the other side.
cards.zh:
Participation constraint（参与限制）：specifies whether each entity of an entity type participates in a relationship or not。

每个关系有两边，每边是：
• mandatory side（强制一面）：每个实体必须参与；或
• optional side（非强制一面）：可参与可不参与。

符号画在靠近对面实体的线上：
图边读法
Student — Join —| Sports eventMandatory（短竖线）每个学生必须参加项目
Student — Join —O Sports eventOptional（小圆圈）学生可参加可不参加
先由左读到右，再由右读到左。

ex.q: Diagram: Employee —|— Have —O— Task, with a bar next to Employee and a circle next to Task. Describe both sides.
